_help: nullCAT car table: how each car's engine, limiter, driveline, ABS and TC feel, keyed game:car (the car's stable id: the content folder for Assetto Corsa, AC EVO and Le Mans Ultimate, the car model id for Competizione, the in-game name for Automobilista 2 and AC Rally), each with the name the sim shows; a car is matched by either. Applied by the Haptics strip when it follows the car or when asked; never carries routes or any rig tuning. Do not edit this file: it is replaced by every update. Your own entries go in cars.local.json (saved from the strip) and win over these.

ac:ks_mazda_787b.name: Mazda 787B
ac:ks_mazda_787b.notes: R26B four-rotor, 4 x 654 cc, NA, about 700 hp, 9000 rpm, idle 2000 (AC reports it flat, hence the frozen-guard false positive). A rotary has no reciprocating mass: almost no idle rock or firing thump, all scream, so buzz 1.0 and the thump carrier high (30 Hz, light). Inertia low (light rotors). Unburnt fuel in the exhaust makes rotaries bang on the overrun: pops 0.8. Porsche-derived 5-speed racing box with dog engagement and straight-cut gears: whine 0.6; racing multiplate clutch, snappy (12 Hz); no low-end torque to lug. 1991 Le Mans car: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_porsche_911_carrera_rsr.name: Porsche 911 Carrera RSR 3.0
ac:ks_porsche_911_carrera_rsr.notes: 1974 air-cooled 3.0 flat-six, about 330 hp, 8000 rpm, lumpy race idle (lope 0.4). Air-cooled flat-six has a distinctive mechanical thrash: thump 0.9 at a heavy 18 Hz carrier, rock 0.7. Bosch mechanical injection burbles on the overrun: pops 0.6. Porsche 915 five-speed with synchromesh (helical gears, quiet: whine 0.2); transaxle lash gives a clear tip-in shunt. 1974 race car: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ferrari_f40.name: Ferrari F40
ac:ferrari_f40.notes: F120A 2.9 twin-turbo V8 with a flat-plane crank, 478 hp, 7750 rpm. Flat-plane V8 buzzes like two inline fours: buzz 0.8, thump 0.7. Twin IHI turbos with big lag and a loud blow-off: turbo on, lift-off 1.6 is the car's signature; the exhaust still pops a little (0.4). Five-speed gated manual, synchro; the transaxle whines audibly (0.3) and the driveline lash on tip-in is well known (shunt 0.7). Road car of 1987: no ABS, no TC.

ac:bmw_m3_e30_gra.name: BMW M3 E30 Group A
ac:bmw_m3_e30_gra.notes: S14 2.3 inline-four with individual throttle bodies and race cams, about 300 hp, 8500 rpm. A big four has strong secondary shake: rock 0.8 at idle, thump 1.0 (the chunkiest in the set), lope 0.5. ITBs crackle on the overrun: pops 0.8. Hard ignition-cut limiter. Group A cars ran Getrag or Prodrive straight-cut boxes with dog engagement: whine 0.8; sintered racing clutch grabs (11 Hz). Late-80s touring car: no ABS, no TC.

ac:lotus_98t.name: Lotus 98T
ac:lotus_98t.notes: 1986 Renault EF15B 1.5 V6 twin-turbo, 900 to 1300 hp depending on boost, 12000 rpm, race boost around 4 bar (the model's boost hit saturates above 1.7 bar, which is right: it is all hit). Tiny engine, instant revs: inertia 0.3; pulses blur at 12k so buzz 1.0, thump 0.5. Massive lag and blow-off: lift-off 2.0, flames on the overrun (pops 0.6). Brutal hard cut. Lotus/Hewland six-speed dog box, straight cut: whine 1.0; carbon twin-plate clutch (14 Hz, launch only); shunt 0.8 from lash plus the boost surge. 1986 F1: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_mazda_mx5_nd.name: Mazda MX5 ND
ac:ks_mazda_mx5_nd.notes: 2015 ND, 2.0 SkyActiv inline-four, 160 hp, 6800 rpm, smooth 750 idle. Road flywheel: revs hang (inertia 0.7). Quiet exhaust, fuel-cut limiter is soft. Six-speed synchro with helical gears: no whine; soft mounts give a noticeable tip-in shunt; long road clutch engagement (8 Hz); it lugs easily in a high gear at 1500 (lug 0.8). Road car: ABS and DSC fitted.

ac:ks_ferrari_f2004.name: Ferrari F2004
ac:ks_ferrari_f2004.notes: Tipo 053 3.0 V10, about 900 hp, 19000 rpm, pneumatic valves, titanium internals: nothing to spin up (inertia 0.2). Firings blur to a scream: buzz 1.0, thump 0.3 at a light 35 Hz carrier. Downshift barks and overrun crackle: pops 0.9. Hardest limiter in the set. Seven-speed cassette gearbox, straight cut, dog engagement: whine 1.0, stiff fast shunt (55 Hz); carbon clutch for launches only. 2004 F1: traction control was legal (banned 2008), so TC on; no ABS.

ac:ks_ford_escort_mk1.name: Ford Escort RS1600
ac:ks_ford_escort_mk1.notes: 1972 Group 2 car. The badge is the 1601 cc road BDA; Group 2 cars ran bored BDAs (1.8, later the 2.0 BDG), litres set 1.8 (only scales thump weight, a few percent either way). Weber carbs and race cams: the lumpiest idle here (rock 0.9, lope 0.6), thump 1.0, open exhaust pops 0.8. Straight-cut bullet box with dog engagement, the loud whine everyone remembers (0.9); paddle clutch (10 Hz). 1972: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_corvette_c7r.name: Chevrolet Corvette C7R
ac:ks_corvette_c7r.notes: 5.5 LS-based cross-plane V8, about 500 hp with the GTE restrictor, 7400 rpm, lumpy 1200 idle. Big cross-plane V8: the rumble and lope (rock 0.9, lope 0.5), heavy pulses (thump 1.0 at a 16 Hz carrier, the heaviest), deep buzz 0.5. Overrun bark 0.7. Xtrac six-speed sequential, straight cut, dog: whine 0.7, lots of torque into the lash (shunt 0.7); carbon triple-plate clutch. GTE/GTLM rules allow ABS and TC: both on.

ac:ks_nissan_skyline_r34.name: Nissan Skyline GTR R34 V-Spec
ac:ks_nissan_skyline_r34.notes: RB26DETT 2.6 inline-six twin-turbo, 280 hp (official), 8000 rpm, smooth 950 idle. A straight six is the smoothest layout here: rock 0.3, lope 0.1, sweet buzz 0.7. Twin turbos flutter on lift (1.2), mild pops. Getrag six-speed synchro, helical (whine 0.1); ATTESA four-wheel-drive gives a little driveline lash; twin-plate road clutch. 1999 road car: ABS yes; no traction control as such (ATTESA/A-LSD are not a TC cut), so TC 0.

ac:ks_bmw_m4_akrapovic.name: BMW M4 Akrapovic
ac:ks_bmw_m4_akrapovic.notes: S55 3.0 inline-six twin-scroll turbo, 431 hp, 7600 rpm. Smooth six: rock 0.3, thump 0.6. The Akrapovic exhaust is the point of this variant: loud overrun crackle (pops 0.7) and a bigger blow-off (lift-off 1.3). Seven-speed DCT: shifts are synchro-shaped (no dog knock), DCT launches judder (clutch 0.9 at 9 Hz). Road car: ABS and DSC on.

ac:abarth500.name: Abarth 500 EsseEsse
ac:abarth500.notes: 1.4 T-Jet inline-four turbo, 160 hp, 6500 rpm. Small four with a heavy road flywheel: modest shake, revs hang (inertia 0.7). Small turbo gives an audible blow-off on lift (1.0) and the Monza exhaust a little crackle. Five-speed synchro, quiet; soft road clutch; lugs happily in a high gear. Road car: ABS and ASR on.

ac:abarth500_s1.name: Abarth 500 EsseEsse Step1
ac:abarth500_s1.notes: Kunos Step 1 tune of the 500: more boost and a freer exhaust, so a bigger lift-off whoosh (1.2) and more crackle (0.4); otherwise the road car. ABS and ASR stay.

ac:ks_abarth_595ss.name: Abarth 595 SS
ac:ks_abarth_595ss.notes: 1960s Fiat 500 based 595, 690 cc air-cooled parallel twin, about 32 hp, 6000 rpm. A big-bore twin at 500 rpm idle shakes the whole car: rock 1.0, thump 1.0 at the heaviest carrier (14 Hz), lope 0.5. Four-speed crash box with no synchro on first, straight-ish cut gears that whine (0.3). Lugs at the slightest excuse (0.9 at 4 Hz). Nothing electronic: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_abarth_595ss_s1.name: Abarth 595 SS Step 1
ac:ks_abarth_595ss_s1.notes: Step 1 of the 595: hotter cam and exhaust, slightly rougher idle and more pop; the twin's shake is the same. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_abarth_595ss_s2.name: Abarth 595 SS Step 2
ac:ks_abarth_595ss_s2.notes: Step 2 of the 595: race cam, lighter flywheel (inertia 0.4), open exhaust (pops 0.7), revs higher with a harder cut. Still the two-cylinder shake. No ABS, no TC.

ac:alfa_romeo_giulietta_qv.name: Giulietta QV
ac:alfa_romeo_giulietta_qv.notes: 1750 TBi inline-four turbo, 235 hp, 6500 rpm, balance shafts so a smooth four. Single turbo blow-off on lift (1.1), soft fuel cut. Six-speed synchro manual, quiet. Road car: ABS and VDC on.

ac:alfa_romeo_giulietta_qv_le.name: Giulietta QV Launch Edition 2014
ac:alfa_romeo_giulietta_qv_le.notes: 2014 Launch Edition: the 240 hp 1750 TBi with the TCT twin-clutch box, so DCT-style shifts (synchro shape) and a little launch judder. ABS and VDC on.

ac:bmw_1m.name: BMW 1M
ac:bmw_1m.notes: N54 3.0 twin-turbo inline-six, 340 hp, 7000 rpm. Smooth six (rock 0.3), twin small turbos flutter on lift (1.1). Six-speed synchro manual, helical. Road car: ABS and DSC on.

ac:bmw_1m_s3.name: BMW 1M Stage 3
ac:bmw_1m_s3.notes: Kunos Stage 3 1M: bigger turbos and an open exhaust, so a much bigger blow-off (1.5), overrun crackle (0.6), lighter flywheel. ABS and DSC still fitted.

ac:bmw_m3_e30.name: BMW M3 E30
ac:bmw_m3_e30.notes: Road S14 2.3 four, 195 hp, 7250 rpm, individual throttle bodies even on the road car so a bit of lope. The same big four as the Group A car with a road flywheel and a quiet exhaust. Getrag 265 dogleg five-speed, synchro, a faint whine. 1986 road car: ABS yes, no traction control.

ac:bmw_m3_e30_drift.name: BMW M3 E30 Drift
ac:bmw_m3_e30_drift.notes: Drift build of the E30: stroked S14, race cams and an open exhaust, light flywheel, grabby clutch for clutch kicks. Limiter gets leaned on constantly in drifting so it is firm. Stripped car: ABS and TC removed.

ac:bmw_m3_e30_dtm.name: BMW M3 E30 Gr.A 92
ac:bmw_m3_e30_dtm.notes: 1991-92 DTM Sport Evolution: 2.5 S14 at about 370 hp and 9000 rpm, lighter internals than the Group A car (inertia 0.35), harder cut. Six-speed straight-cut dog box: whine 0.9. Sintered clutch. DTM of that era: no ABS, no TC.

ac:bmw_m3_e30_s1.name: BMW M3 E30 Step1
ac:bmw_m3_e30_s1.notes: Kunos Step 1 of the road E30: freer exhaust and a mild cam, so more pop and a slightly lighter feel; the rest is the road car. ABS yes, no TC.

ac:bmw_m3_e92.name: BMW M3 E92
ac:bmw_m3_e92.notes: S65 4.0 cross-plane V8, 420 hp, 8400 rpm, individual throttle bodies: a high-revving road V8, more buzz than rumble (buzz 0.8, rock 0.4). Seven-speed M-DCT in AC: synchro-shaped shifts with launch judder. Road car: ABS and DSC on.

ac:bmw_m3_e92_drift.name: BMW M3 E92 drift
ac:bmw_m3_e92_drift.notes: Drift E92: S65 with headers and open exhaust (pops 0.7), light flywheel, manual box with a grabby clutch for kicks. ABS and DSC removed.

ac:bmw_m3_e92_s1.name: BMW M3 E92 Step1
ac:bmw_m3_e92_s1.notes: Step 1 E92: exhaust and intake, more crackle on the overrun, a touch lighter. Road electronics stay: ABS and DSC on.

ac:bmw_m3_gt2.name: BMW M3 GT2
ac:bmw_m3_gt2.notes: 2009-12 ALMS/Le Mans GT2 car: race P65 V8, about 500 hp restricted, 8500 rpm, side-exit exhaust that cracks on the overrun (0.8). Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.8); carbon clutch. GT2 rules of the time: ABS and TC allowed, both on.

ac:bmw_z4.name: BMW Z4 E89
ac:bmw_z4.notes: N54 3.0 twin-turbo six, 340 hp, with the seven-speed DCT. Smooth six, modest blow-off, DCT shifts synchro-shaped. Road car: ABS and DSC on.

ac:bmw_z4_drift.name: BMW Z4 E89 Drift
ac:bmw_z4_drift.notes: Drift Z4: bigger turbos and open exhaust (lift-off 1.5, pops 0.6), manual box with a grabby clutch. ABS and DSC removed.

ac:bmw_z4_s1.name: BMW Z4 E89 Step1
ac:bmw_z4_s1.notes: Step 1 Z4: remap and exhaust, a bigger blow-off and some crackle. ABS and DSC on.

ac:bmw_z4_gt3.name: BMW Z4 GT3
ac:bmw_z4_gt3.notes: 4.4 P65-derived cross-plane V8, about 515 hp, 8000 rpm, side exhaust bark (0.8). Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.8), carbon clutch. GT3 rules: ABS and TC on.

ac:ferrari_458.name: Ferrari 458 Italia
ac:ferrari_458.notes: F136 4.5 flat-plane V8, 570 hp, 9000 rpm. Flat-plane crank: a high buzz (0.9), little rumble, quick revs (inertia 0.4). Seven-speed Getrag DCT: synchro-shaped shifts. Road car: ABS and F1-Trac on.

ac:ferrari_458_gt2.name: Ferrari 458 GT2
ac:ferrari_458_gt2.notes: GTE version of the 458: restricted to about 470 hp but the scream is louder and the overrun cracks (0.8). Hewland six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.8), carbon clutch. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ac:ferrari_458_s3.name: Ferrari 458 Italia Stage 3
ac:ferrari_458_s3.notes: Kunos Stage 3 458: race exhaust and lighter flywheel on the road DCT car, more crackle and sharper revs. ABS and TC stay.

ac:ferrari_599xxevo.name: Ferrari 599XX EVO
ac:ferrari_599xxevo.notes: 6.0 V12 at 750 hp and 9000 rpm, track-only. A V12 is inherently balanced: no rock, all buzz (1.0) with a big overrun crackle (0.8). F1 single-clutch sequential, race-spec with straight-cut gears (whine 0.6, dog-shaped shifts). XX programme car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ferrari_laferrari.name: Ferrari LaFerrari
ac:ferrari_laferrari.notes: 6.3 V12 plus HY-KERS, 963 hp combined, 9250 rpm. Balanced V12, all buzz; the electric fill means the lift is softer than a pure race V12 (1.1). Seven-speed DCT. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ferrari_312t.name: Ferrari 312T
ac:ferrari_312t.notes: 1975 flat-12 (180 degree V12), 3.0 litres, about 500 hp, 12200 rpm, mechanical injection and an uneven high idle (lope 0.4). Flat-12 screams, light internals (inertia 0.3), big overrun bang. Transverse five-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1975 F1: nothing electronic.

ac:ktm_xbow_r.name: KTM X-Bow R
ac:ktm_xbow_r.notes: Audi 2.0 TFSI four, 300 hp, in a carbon tub with the engine rigidly mounted behind you: everything comes through (rock and thump 0.6, big blow-off 1.4 with no bodywork to hide it). Six-speed Audi manual, synchro. Has ABS; no TC on the R.

ac:lotus_2_eleven.name: Lotus 2-Eleven
ac:lotus_2_eleven.notes: Supercharged Toyota 2ZZ 1.8 four, 255 hp, 8000 rpm, 745 kg with no roof. Supercharger whine rides on the buzz (0.8); the model's turbo flag is for blow-off so it stays off, the lift-off is set higher (1.2) for the blower's bypass sigh. Six-speed synchro. Lotus traction control fitted, no ABS on the 2-Eleven.

ac:lotus_2_eleven_gt4.name: Lotus 2-Eleven GT4
ac:lotus_2_eleven_gt4.notes: GT4 race version: more power, open exhaust (pops 0.7), sequential dog box with straight-cut gears (whine 0.7). TC yes, no ABS.

ac:lotus_49.name: Lotus Type 49
ac:lotus_49.notes: 1967 Cosworth DFV 3.0 V8, flat-plane crank, 410 hp, 9000 rpm, the engine is a stressed chassis member so you sit on it: rock 0.6, thump 0.8, rough idle (lope 0.5). ZF five-speed straight-cut dog box bolted behind you: whine 1.0. 1967: nothing electronic.

ac:lotus_elise_sc.name: Lotus Elise SC
ac:lotus_elise_sc.notes: Supercharged 2ZZ 1.8 four, 220 hp, 8000 rpm, aluminium tub so the engine is felt more than in a steel car. Six-speed synchro. Road car: ABS and Lotus TC on.

ac:lotus_elise_sc_s1.name: Lotus Elise SC Step1
ac:lotus_elise_sc_s1.notes: Step 1 Elise SC: pulley and exhaust, slightly more of everything. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_elise_sc_s2.name: Lotus Elise SC Step2
ac:lotus_elise_sc_s2.notes: Step 2 Elise SC: cams and a lighter flywheel on top, crackle on the overrun. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_gtc.name: Lotus Evora GTC
ac:lotus_evora_gtc.notes: GTC cup version of the Evora: NA 4.0 Toyota V6 at about 440 hp, open exhaust, sequential dog box with straight-cut gears (whine 0.8). Cup rules: ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_gte.name: Lotus Evora GTE
ac:lotus_evora_gte.notes: 2011 GTE car: 4.0 V6 with race internals, 450 hp, six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.8), carbon clutch. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_gte_carbon.name: Lotus Evora GTE Carbon
ac:lotus_evora_gte_carbon.notes: The carbon-bodied GTE: mechanically the GTE, same values. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_gx.name: Lotus Evora GX
ac:lotus_evora_gx.notes: ALMS GX-class Evora: the GTE car on E85, same engine and box. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_s.name: Lotus Evora S
ac:lotus_evora_s.notes: Supercharged Toyota 3.5 V6, 350 hp, 7000 rpm; the blower's bypass sighs on lift (1.0, turbo flag off). Six-speed synchro. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_evora_s_s2.name: Lotus Evora S Stage 2
ac:lotus_evora_s_s2.notes: Stage 2 Evora S: smaller pulley, exhaust, lighter flywheel, more crackle. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_exige_240.name: Lotus Exige 240R
ac:lotus_exige_240.notes: Supercharged 2ZZ 1.8 four, 240 hp, 8000 rpm; same family as the Elise SC with a bit more edge. Six-speed synchro. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_exige_240_s3.name: Lotus Exige 240R Stage3
ac:lotus_exige_240_s3.notes: Stage 3 track build of the 240R: big pulley, cams, light flywheel, open exhaust, close-ratio box with some whine (0.3). Track car: TC kept, ABS removed in the Kunos build.

ac:lotus_exige_s.name: Lotus Exige S
ac:lotus_exige_s.notes: 2012 Exige S: supercharged 3.5 V6, 350 hp, 7000 rpm, lighter than the Evora so the engine is more present. Six-speed synchro. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_exige_s_roadster.name: Lotus Exige S roadster
ac:lotus_exige_s_roadster.notes: The roadster is the Exige S without the roof: identical engine and box. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_exige_scura.name: Lotus Exige Scura
ac:lotus_exige_scura.notes: Exige Scura (Stealth): the 260 hp supercharged 2ZZ with the lightweight pack and sports exhaust. ABS and TC on.

ac:lotus_exige_v6_cup.name: Lotus Exige V6 CUP
ac:lotus_exige_v6_cup.notes: Cup version of the Exige S: race exhaust (pops 0.7), close-ratio manual with a little whine, racier clutch. Cup car keeps ABS and TC.

ac:lotus_exos_125.name: Lotus Exos 125
ac:lotus_exos_125.notes: Cosworth GPV8 3.5 V8, 640 hp, 10300 rpm, a customer F1-style car: scream (buzz 1.0), nothing to spin up (inertia 0.25), hard cut. Six-speed sequential cassette box, straight cut, dog. The T125 ran traction control; no ABS.

ac:lotus_exos_125_s1.name: Lotus Exos 125 Stage 1
ac:lotus_exos_125_s1.notes: Stage 1 T125: higher rev limit and more power, otherwise the T125. TC yes, no ABS.

ac:mclaren_mp412c.name: McLaren MP4-12C
ac:mclaren_mp412c.notes: M838T 3.8 twin-turbo flat-plane V8, 600 hp, 8500 rpm. Flat-plane buzz (0.85) with two turbos that breathe hard on lift (1.4). Seven-speed Graziano DCT. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:mclaren_mp412c_gt3.name: McLaren MP4-12C GT3
ac:mclaren_mp412c_gt3.notes: GT3 12C: restricted to about 500 hp, race exhaust with turbo flutter and pop on lift (1.6, 0.7). Ricardo six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.8). GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:mercedes_sls.name: Mercedes SLS AMG
ac:mercedes_sls.notes: M159 6.2 cross-plane V8, 571 hp, 7200 rpm: big-displacement rumble (rock 0.7, thump 0.9 at a heavy 18 Hz) and the AMG overrun burble (0.6). Seven-speed transaxle DCT, synchro-shaped. Road car: ABS and ESP on.

ac:mercedes_sls_gt3.name: Mercedes SLS AMG GT3
ac:mercedes_sls_gt3.notes: GT3 SLS: the 6.2 V8 with a side-exit race exhaust, the loudest overrun in GT3 of its day (pops 0.8), lumpy race idle. Hewland six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.8). GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:p4-5_2011.name: P4/5 Competizione 2011
ac:p4-5_2011.notes: Glickenhaus one-off on 458 GT2 running gear: the 4.5 flat-plane V8 race engine and the Hewland sequential, so it feels like the 458 GT2. ABS and TC on (Nürburgring 24h spec).

ac:pagani_huayra.name: Pagani Huayra
ac:pagani_huayra.notes: AMG M158 6.0 twin-turbo V12, 730 hp, 6200 rpm. Balanced V12 so little rock; two big turbos give a long blow-off on lift (1.5). Seven-speed Xtrac single-clutch sequential: a little whine (0.2), noticeable shunt. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:pagani_zonda_r.name: Pagani Zonda R
ac:pagani_zonda_r.notes: AMG 6.0 NA V12 from the CLK-GTR, 750 hp, 8000 rpm, track only, titanium exhaust that screams and cracks (pops 0.8). Xtrac six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). Track car: ABS and TC on.

ac:shelby_cobra_427sc.name: Shelby Cobra 427 S/C
ac:shelby_cobra_427sc.notes: 427 FE big-block V8, 7.0 litres, about 480 hp, 6500 rpm, side pipes. The lumpiest idle and heaviest pulses of any V8 here: rock 1.0, thump 1.0 at the lowest carrier (14 Hz), lope 0.5, big flywheel (inertia 0.7). Toploader four-speed, synchro; huge driveline lash on tip-in (shunt 0.8). 1965: nothing electronic.

ac:tatuusfa1.name: Tatuus FA01
ac:tatuusfa1.notes: 1.4 T-Jet four, 190 hp, 7000 rpm, rigidly mounted in a single-seater: the small four's shake comes straight through. Turbo blow-off (1.3). Sadev six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). Junior formula: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ruf_yellowbird.name: RUF CTR Yellowbird
ac:ruf_yellowbird.notes: 1987 air-cooled 3.4 flat-six with two big turbos, 470 hp, 7000 rpm. Air-cooled boxer thrash (thump 0.8, rock 0.7) and the most violent lag-and-dump of the road cars: lift-off 1.8. RUF five-speed synchro, transaxle lash. 1987: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_corvette_c7_stingray.name: Chevrolet Corvette C7 Stingray
ac:ks_corvette_c7_stingray.notes: LT1 6.2 cross-plane V8, 460 hp, 6500 rpm, pushrod lope at idle (rock 0.8), heavy pulses (16 Hz). Seven-speed Tremec manual, synchro; noticeable lash. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_alfa_mito_qv.name: Alfa Romeo Mito QV
ac:ks_alfa_mito_qv.notes: 1.4 MultiAir turbo four, 170 hp, 6500 rpm, a hot hatch: smooth, heavy flywheel, small blow-off. Six-speed synchro. Road car: ABS and VDC on.

ac:ks_audi_a1s1.name: Audi S1
ac:ks_audi_a1s1.notes: 2.0 TFSI four, 231 hp, quattro: smooth, well isolated, small blow-off. Six-speed synchro; AWD takes up lash softly. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_abarth500_assetto_corse.name: Abarth 500 Assetto Corse
ac:ks_abarth500_assetto_corse.notes: One-make race 500: 1.4 turbo at 190 hp, stripped shell (the four's shake comes through), race exhaust with blow-off and pop, Sadev sequential dog box with straight-cut gears (whine 0.7). Race car: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_performante.name: Lamborghini Huracan Performante
ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_performante.notes: 5.2 NA V10, 640 hp, 8500 rpm, a smooth high-revving ten with a loud overrun (pops 0.7). Seven-speed DCT, AWD. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_pagani_huayra_bc.name: Pagani Huayra BC
ac:ks_pagani_huayra_bc.notes: The lighter BC: 6.0 twin-turbo V12 at 790 hp with a titanium exhaust (more pop, bigger blow-off than the Huayra) and the Xtrac sequential. ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_nissan_370z.name: Nissan 370z Nismo
ac:ks_nissan_370z.notes: VQ37VHR 3.7 V6, 344 hp, 7500 rpm; a 60-degree V6 has a bit of coarseness at the top (buzz 0.7). Six-speed synchro manual. Road car: ABS and VDC on.

ac:ks_toyota_gt86.name: Toyota GT86
ac:ks_toyota_gt86.notes: FA20 2.0 flat-four, 200 hp, 7400 rpm: a boxer four has its own gruffness (thump 0.6) and the famous torque dip means it lugs if you let it (0.7). Six-speed synchro. Road car: ABS and VSC on.

ac:ferrari_f40_s3.name: Ferrari F40 Stage 3
ac:ferrari_f40_s3.notes: Kunos Stage 3 F40: more boost and a straight-through exhaust, so the blow-off is bigger still (1.8) and it pops. Same gated manual. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_praga_r1.name: Praga R1
ac:ks_praga_r1.notes: Renault 2.0 turbo four, 210 hp, 7000 rpm, rigidly mounted in a 600 kg carbon prototype: direct engine feel, turbo blow-off. Hewland six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). Prototype: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_alfa_romeo_155_v6.name: Alfa Romeo 155 TI V6
ac:ks_alfa_romeo_155_v6.notes: 1993 DTM car: 2.5 60-degree V6, 420 hp, 11800 rpm, the highest-revving tin-top of its era: buzz 1.0 at a light carrier, near-zero inertia (0.3), screaming cut. Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut, whine 1.0; four-wheel drive. The 1993-96 DTM cars ran ABS and traction control (banned later), so both on.

ac:ks_alfa_romeo_4c.name: Alfa Romeo 4C
ac:ks_alfa_romeo_4c.notes: 1750 TBi four, 240 hp, in a 900 kg carbon tub with the engine right behind you: more engine feel than the Giulietta, a louder blow-off (1.3). TCT twin-clutch. Road car: ABS and VDC on.

ac:ks_alfa_romeo_gta.name: Alfa Romeo GTA
ac:ks_alfa_romeo_gta.notes: 1965 twin-cam 1.6 four with twin-plug head and Webers, 170 hp race trim, 7500 rpm: lumpy carburettor idle (lope 0.5), rock 0.85, thump 0.9, pops on the overrun. Five-speed synchro with a touch of gear noise (0.4). 1965: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_bmw_m235i_racing.name: BMW M235i Racing
ac:ks_bmw_m235i_racing.notes: N55 3.0 single-turbo six at 333 hp in a VLN cup car with a race exhaust: blow-off and pop on lift. Six-speed ZF automatic in AC (synchro-shaped shifts). Cup car keeps ABS and DSC.

ac:ks_glickenhaus_scg003.name: SCG 003C
ac:ks_glickenhaus_scg003.notes: Honda-derived 3.5 twin-turbo V6, about 530 hp, 8000 rpm, in a carbon prototype for the Nürburgring 24h: big turbo breathing on lift (1.7), scream. Hewland six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut. SP-X rules: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_mclaren_650_gt3.name: McLaren 650S GT3
ac:ks_mclaren_650_gt3.notes: The 12C GT3 updated: same M838T twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at about 500 hp and the Ricardo sequential dog box. Values match the 12C GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_mclaren_f1_gtr.name: McLaren F1 GTR
ac:ks_mclaren_f1_gtr.notes: 1995 Le Mans winner: BMW S70/2 6.1 V12, 600 hp restricted, 7500 rpm, race exhaust that cracks on the overrun. Six-speed straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9), carbon clutch. 1995 GT1: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_mercedes_190_evo2.name: Mercedes-Benz 190E EVO II
ac:ks_mercedes_190_evo2.notes: 1992 DTM Evo II: Cosworth-headed 2.5 four at 375 hp and 10000 rpm, the E30 DTM car's direct rival and the same character (big four, light internals, hard cut). Straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9). The AMG DTM cars ran ABS from 1992; traction control came later, so ABS on, TC off.

ac:ks_nissan_gtr_gt3.name: Nissan GT-R GT3
ac:ks_nissan_gtr_gt3.notes: VR38DETT 3.8 twin-turbo V6 at about 550 hp in GT3 trim, rear-drive only. Turbo flutter and pop on lift. Ricardo six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.8). GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_ruf_rt12r.name: RUF RT12 R
ac:ks_ruf_rt12r.notes: 997-based 3.8 twin-turbo flat-six at 730 hp, rear-drive: water-cooled boxer (less thrash than the Yellowbird), two big turbos dumping on lift (1.6). Six-speed synchro manual. Modern road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_ruf_rt12r_awd.name: RUF RT12 R AWD
ac:ks_ruf_rt12r_awd.notes: The all-wheel-drive RT12 R: same engine and box; AWD takes the lash up more gently (shunt 0.5). ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_audi_r8_lms.name: Audi R8 LMS Ultra
ac:ks_audi_r8_lms.notes: 5.2 NA V10 at about 560 hp, 8500 rpm, race exhaust with a loud overrun (0.8). Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.8). GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro.name: Audi Sport quattro
ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro.notes: Road Sport quattro: 2.1 turbo inline-five, 306 hp, 7000 rpm. The five-cylinder has an odd-fire warble (thump 0.8 at a 20 Hz carrier, some lope) and a big single turbo that dumps on lift (1.6). Five-speed synchro, quattro. 1984 road car: ABS fitted, no TC.

ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro_rally.name: Audi Sport quattro S1 E2
ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro_rally.notes: 1985 Group B monster: 2.1 five at 500 plus hp with a huge KKK turbo and anti-lag bangs, 8000 rpm. The five's warble, anti-lag crackle (pops 0.9) and the most violent lift in the set (2.0). Six-speed straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9), lots of driveline shunt. Group B: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro_s1.name: Audi Sport quattro Step1
ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro_s1.notes: Kunos Step 1 tune of the road Sport quattro: the same 2.1 turbo five on more boost (about 400 hp), so a bigger dump on lift (1.8) and a touch more overrun crackle; still the five-speed synchro road box and quattro. ABS on, no TC (1984).

ac:ks_bmw_m4.name: BMW M4
ac:ks_bmw_m4.notes: S55 3.0 twin-scroll turbo six, 431 hp, 7600 rpm, stock exhaust: the Akrapovic car with less pop and a smaller blow-off. Seven-speed DCT. Road car: ABS and DSC on.

ac:ks_ford_gt40.name: Ford GT40
ac:ks_ford_gt40.notes: 1966 Mk I: 4.7 (289) cross-plane small-block V8 with Webers, about 390 hp, 7000 rpm, sitting right behind your head: heavy pulses (16 Hz), lumpy idle (lope 0.5), open exhaust bark. ZF five-speed transaxle, straight cut, dog engagement (whine 0.9). 1966: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_lamborghini_countach.name: Lamborghini Countach
ac:ks_lamborghini_countach.notes: 5.2 V12 on six Weber downdraughts, 455 hp, 7500 rpm: a carburetted V12 has an uneven idle (lope 0.3) and a loud overrun. The gearbox sits in front of the engine with a shaft running back through the sump: notable gear noise (0.4) and lash (shunt 0.7); heavy clutch. 1985: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_lamborghini_countach_s1.name: Lamborghini Countach S1
ac:ks_lamborghini_countach_s1.notes: Step 1 Countach: cams and open exhaust on the carburetted V12, more crackle. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_gt3.name: Lamborghini Huracan GT3
ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_gt3.notes: The same 5.2 V10 and X-trac sequential as the Audi R8 LMS, rear-drive. Values match the R8 LMS. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_miura_sv.name: Lamborghini Miura P400 SV
ac:ks_lamborghini_miura_sv.notes: Transverse 3.9 V12 on four triple-choke Webers, 385 hp, 7850 rpm, mounted inches behind the seats: carburettor lumpiness (lope 0.35) and a very present engine. The gearbox shares the engine's oil and sits in unit with it: constant gear whine (0.5) and lash. 1971: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_nissan_gtr.name: Nissan GT-R NISMO
ac:ks_nissan_gtr.notes: VR38DETT 3.8 twin-turbo V6, 600 hp Nismo tune, 7100 rpm, AWD. Two turbos dump on lift (1.4). Six-speed rear-mounted DCT transaxle: a little mechanical whine and DCT launch judder. Road car: ABS and VDC on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_gallardo_sl.name: Lamborghini Gallardo SL
ac:ks_lamborghini_gallardo_sl.notes: 5.2 V10, 570 hp, 8000 rpm, AWD. The e-gear single-clutch automated manual: a sharper shunt on shifts than a DCT (0.6), a little whine. Road car: ABS and ESP on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_gallardo_sl_s3.name: Lamborghini Gallardo SL Step3
ac:ks_lamborghini_gallardo_sl_s3.notes: Stage 3 Superleggera: straight-pipe exhaust (pops 0.8) and a lighter flywheel. ABS and ESP on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_st.name: Lamborghini Huracan ST
ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_st.notes: One-make Super Trofeo: 620 hp V10, X-trac sequential dog box, same family as the Huracan GT3. Cup car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_lotus_25.name: Lotus Type 25
ac:ks_lotus_25.notes: 1962-63 Coventry Climax FWMV 1.5 V8, about 200 hp, 9500 rpm, in the first monocoque F1 car: a small V8 with a rough carburetted idle (lope 0.5), light internals. ZF five-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1963: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_lotus_72d.name: Lotus 72D
ac:ks_lotus_72d.notes: 1972 Cosworth DFV 3.0 flat-plane V8, 450 hp, 10500 rpm, the engine is the chassis rear: same character as the Lotus 49 with a little more rev and edge. Hewland FG400 five-speed straight-cut dog box (whine 1.0). 1972: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_mercedes_amg_gt3.name: Mercedes-Benz AMG GT3
ac:ks_mercedes_amg_gt3.notes: The SLS GT3's M159 6.2 V8 carried over, side exhaust, same lumpy big-V8 race idle and overrun bark; Hewland sequential dog box. Values match the SLS GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_mercedes_c9.name: Mercedes-Benz C9 1989 LM
ac:ks_mercedes_c9.notes: 1989 Le Mans winner: M119 5.0 twin-turbo V8, 720 hp race trim, 7000 rpm, 400 km/h on the Mulsanne. Big V8 pulses (18 Hz) and two big KKK turbos that dump hard on lift (1.8), heavy shunt from the torque. Five-speed straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9). 1989 Group C: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_alfa_33_stradale.name: Alfa Romeo 33 Stradale
ac:ks_alfa_33_stradale.notes: 1967 road version of the Tipo 33 racer: 2.0 flat-plane V8 on mechanical injection, 230 hp, 10000 rpm, a tiny screaming V8 with a lumpy idle (lope 0.4). Six-speed Colotti transaxle, synchro but noisy (whine 0.5). 1967: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_mazda_miata.name: Mazda Miata NA
ac:ks_mazda_miata.notes: 1989 NA, B6 1.6 four, 115 hp, 7000 rpm, a slightly busier idle than the ND (rock 0.65). Five-speed synchro, the sweetest shift in the business. Base 1989 car: no ABS (an option later), no TC.

ac:ks_mazda_mx5_cup.name: Mazda MX5 Cup
ac:ks_mazda_mx5_cup.notes: Global MX-5 Cup ND: sealed 2.0 four, race exhaust, stripped shell so the engine is more present; six-speed synchro with a close-ratio set that hums a little. Cup rules keep ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_mazda_rx7_spirit_r.name: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R
ac:ks_mazda_rx7_spirit_r.notes: 13B-REW twin-rotor 1.3 with sequential twin turbos, 280 hp, 8000 rpm. Rotary smoothness (rock 0.3, all buzz), the sequential turbos' handover and dump on lift (1.5), the odd rotary idle wobble (lope 0.2). Five-speed synchro. 2002 road car: ABS yes, no TC.

ac:ks_mazda_rx7_tuned.name: Mazda RX-7 Tuned
ac:ks_mazda_rx7_tuned.notes: Single big-turbo tuned 13B at about 450 hp: lumpy bridge-port idle (lope 0.3), a huge blow-off (1.9) and rotary fireballs on the overrun (pops 0.8). Grabby clutch. Tuner car: ABS and TC removed.

ac:ks_toyota_ae86.name: Toyota AE86
ac:ks_toyota_ae86.notes: 4A-GE 1.6 twin-cam four, 130 hp, 7700 rpm, a light 1985 shell with solid mounts so the four buzzes through (rock 0.7). T50 five-speed synchro, a little gear noise and lash from the live axle. 1985: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_toyota_ae86_drift.name: Toyota AE86 Drift
ac:ks_toyota_ae86_drift.notes: Drift-spec 4A-GE on individual throttle bodies and cams, light flywheel, open exhaust (pops 0.7), limiter used as a tool. Grabby clutch for kicks, close-ratio box. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_toyota_ae86_tuned.name: Toyota AE86 Tuned
ac:ks_toyota_ae86_tuned.notes: Tuned street AE86: ITBs and cams, race exhaust, a touch less extreme than the drift car. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv.name: Toyota Supra MKIV
ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv.notes: 2JZ-GTE 3.0 inline-six with sequential twin turbos, 330 hp, 6800 rpm: silky six, the sequential turbos' handover and dump (1.3). Getrag V160 six-speed synchro. Road car: ABS and TRAC on.

ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv_drift.name: Toyota Supra MKIV Drift
ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv_drift.notes: Drift Supra: single big turbo on the 2JZ at 700 plus hp, the loudest blow-off in the set (2.0) and flames on the overrun (0.8). Grabby clutch. ABS and TRAC removed.

ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv_tuned.name: Toyota Supra MKIV Time Attack
ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv_tuned.notes: Street-tuned Supra: single turbo at about 600 hp, big blow-off, some pop, stock-ish driveline. Tuner car in the Kunos data keeps ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_toyota_celica_st185.name: Toyota Celica ST185 4WD Turbo
ac:ks_toyota_celica_st185.notes: 1992 WRC Group A: 3S-GTE 2.0 turbo four at 300 hp with anti-lag, so the bangs are constant (pops 0.9) and the lift is violent (1.8). Six-speed straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9), four-wheel drive with plenty of shunt. Group A rally car: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_toyota_ts040.name: Toyota TS040 Hybrid 2014
ac:ks_toyota_ts040.notes: 2014 LMP1: 3.7 NA V8 at 520 hp plus 480 hp of hybrid, 7500 rpm. Smooth V8 scream; the electric fill softens the lift (0.9) and the harvesting adds a whine of its own, folded into the gear whine (1.0 on a sequential dog box). LMP1 hybrids ran traction control; no ABS.

ac:ks_ferrari_f138.name: Ferrari F138
ac:ks_ferrari_f138.notes: 2013 F1: 2.4 V8 at 750 hp and the 18000 rpm cap, KERS. Pure scream, no inertia, the hard cut. Seven-speed seamless-shift box (dog, straight cut, whine 1.0; shifts so fast the shunt is small). 2013 rules: no TC (banned 2008), no ABS.

ac:ks_ferrari_sf15t.name: Ferrari SF15-T
ac:ks_ferrari_sf15t.notes: 2015 hybrid F1: 1.6 V6 turbo at 15000 rpm with the MGU-H spinning the turbo, so there is almost no blow-off or lag to feel (lift-off 1.0, turbo on for the boost hit only) and the exhaust is muted (pops 0.4). Eight-speed seamless box, whine 1.0. 2015 rules: no TC, no ABS.

ac:ks_ferrari_488_gt3.name: Ferrari 488 GT3
ac:ks_ferrari_488_gt3.notes: F154 3.9 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at about 550 hp restricted: flat-plane buzz with big turbos that flutter and dump on lift (1.6), race exhaust pop. Hewland six-speed sequential dog box. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_ferrari_488_gtb.name: Ferrari 488 GTB
ac:ks_ferrari_488_gtb.notes: Road 488: 3.9 twin-turbo flat-plane V8, 670 hp, 8000 rpm; the turbos are tuned for little lag so the lift is moderate (1.3). Seven-speed DCT. Road car: ABS and F1-Trac on.

ac:ks_ferrari_fxx_k.name: Ferrari FXX K
ac:ks_ferrari_fxx_k.notes: Track-only LaFerrari: 6.3 V12 at 860 hp plus 190 hp electric, 9250 rpm, open exhaust (pops 0.8). The DCT is race-prepped with straight-cut gears in the Kunos data, so dog-shaped shifts with a mid whine (0.6). XX car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_aventador_sv.name: Lamborghini Aventador SV
ac:ks_lamborghini_aventador_sv.notes: 6.5 NA V12, 750 hp, 8500 rpm, loud overrun (0.7). The ISR single-clutch automated manual slams its shifts: shunt 0.7, synchro-shaped. AWD. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_maserati_alfieri.name: Maserati Alfieri
ac:ks_maserati_alfieri.notes: 2014 concept with the 4.7 Ferrari-built cross-plane V8 (460 hp): the GranTurismo's engine, a warm rumble and the Maserati overrun burble. Six-speed automatic in AC. Concept road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_maserati_gt_mc_gt4.name: Maserati GranTurismo MC GT4
ac:ks_maserati_gt_mc_gt4.notes: GT4 race GranTurismo: 4.7 V8 with a race exhaust that cracks on the overrun (0.8), six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.7). GT4 rules: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_maserati_levante.name: Maserati Levante S
ac:ks_maserati_levante.notes: The SUV: 3.0 twin-turbo V6 at 430 hp, 2.2 tonnes, eight-speed torque-converter automatic that smothers everything. Everything low; it is here for completeness. ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_maserati_250f_6cyl.name: Maserati 250F 6 cylinder
ac:ks_maserati_250f_6cyl.notes: 1957 2.5 straight-six on three Webers, 270 hp, 8000 rpm, in a spaceframe with no isolation: the roughest idle in the set (lope 0.6), rock 0.9, thump 1.0 at 16 Hz, open megaphone exhaust. Five-speed transaxle, straight cut, no synchro (whine 1.0, crash shifts). 1957: nothing electronic; the limiter is you.

ac:ks_maserati_250f_12cyl.name: Maserati 250F 12 cylinder
ac:ks_maserati_250f_12cyl.notes: The experimental 2.5 V12 250F: 310 hp at 10000 rpm, smoother than the six but still carburetted and rigidly mounted; a scream rather than a thump. Same crash gearbox. 1957: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_maserati_quattroporte.name: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
ac:ks_maserati_quattroporte.notes: 3.8 twin-turbo cross-plane V8 at 530 hp in a two-tonne saloon with an eight-speed automatic: soft rumble, soft everything, a bit of overrun burble. ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_porsche_911_gt1.name: Porsche 911 GT1-98
ac:ks_porsche_911_gt1.notes: 1998 Le Mans winner: 3.2 water-cooled twin-turbo flat-six at 550 hp restricted, 7000 rpm, in a carbon prototype: two big turbos dumping on lift (1.8), heavy shunt. Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). 1998 GT1: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_cup_2017.name: Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 2017
ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_cup_2017.notes: 991.2 Cup: 4.0 NA flat-six at 485 hp, 8500 rpm, race exhaust (pops 0.8), hard cut. Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). The Cup car has no ABS and no TC by regulation.

ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_r_2016.name: Porsche 911 GT3 R 2016
ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_r_2016.notes: The GT3-class version of the 991 Cup engine and box, about 500 hp with the BoP. Same feel as the Cup car; GT3 rules add ABS and TC, both on.

ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_rs.name: Porsche 911 GT3 RS
ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_rs.notes: Road 991 GT3 RS: 4.0 NA flat-six, 500 hp, 8800 rpm, a race-derived engine with a road exhaust (pops 0.6). Seven-speed PDK. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_911_r.name: Porsche 911 R
ac:ks_porsche_911_r.notes: The GT3 RS engine with a six-speed manual and a single-mass flywheel (inertia 0.35, a touch of drivetrain rattle at idle). Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_917_30.name: Porsche 917/30 Spyder
ac:ks_porsche_917_30.notes: 1973 Can-Am: 5.4 air-cooled twin-turbo flat-12, 1100 plus hp, 7800 rpm. Lag you can time with a watch and a dump to match (lift-off 2.0), the biggest shunt in the set (0.9) as the boost arrives, air-cooled thrash. Four-speed straight-cut dog box. 1973: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_porsche_917_k.name: Porsche 917 K
ac:ks_porsche_917_k.notes: 1970 Le Mans winner: 4.9 air-cooled NA flat-12, 600 hp, 8400 rpm, mechanical injection: the air-cooled thrash of the RSR times two, a howl on top (buzz 0.9) and bangs on the overrun. Five-speed straight-cut dog box with the famous gear whine (1.0). 1970: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_porsche_918_spyder.name: Porsche 918 Spyder
ac:ks_porsche_918_spyder.notes: 4.6 flat-plane V8 from the RS Spyder at 608 hp plus 280 hp electric, 9150 rpm, top-exit exhausts right behind the headrests (pops 0.6). The electric fill softens the lift. Seven-speed PDK. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_919_hybrid_2015.name: Porsche 919 Hybrid 2015
ac:ks_porsche_919_hybrid_2015.notes: LMP1: 2.0 turbo V4 at 500 hp with 400 hp of electric front drive, 9000 rpm, exhaust-energy recovery so the turbo never really dumps (lift 0.9, turbo on for the hit only) and the exhaust is muted. A V4 at 90 degrees is a coarse engine (thump 0.6). Seven-speed sequential dog box, whine 1.0. LMP1 hybrid: TC on, no ABS.

ac:ks_porsche_919_hybrid_2016.name: Porsche 919 Hybrid 2016
ac:ks_porsche_919_hybrid_2016.notes: The 2016 evolution: same V4 hybrid layout, more power, same feel. TC on, no ABS.

ac:ks_porsche_935_78_moby_dick.name: Porsche 935/78 'Moby Dick'
ac:ks_porsche_935_78_moby_dick.notes: 1978 Group 5: 3.2 twin-turbo flat-six with water-cooled heads, 845 hp, 8200 rpm, 366 km/h at Le Mans. Turbo lag and dump at their most brutal (2.0), flames on the overrun (0.8), heavy shunt. Four-speed straight-cut dog box. 1978: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_porsche_962c_longtail.name: Porsche 962 C Long Tail
ac:ks_porsche_962c_longtail.notes: Group C 962C in Le Mans long-tail trim: 3.0 twin-turbo flat-six at 700 hp, 8200 rpm, Motronic injection (a little tidier than the 935). Big turbo dump (1.8). Five-speed straight-cut dog box. 1980s Group C: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_porsche_962c_shorttail.name: Porsche 962 C Short Tail
ac:ks_porsche_962c_shorttail.notes: The sprint-bodied 962C: same engine and box as the long tail. No ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_porsche_991_carrera_s.name: Porsche 911 Carrera S
ac:ks_porsche_991_carrera_s.notes: 991.1 Carrera S: 3.8 NA flat-six, 400 hp, 7800 rpm, a civilised modern boxer with the sports exhaust burble. Seven-speed PDK. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_991_turbo_s.name: Porsche 911 Turbo S
ac:ks_porsche_991_turbo_s.notes: 3.8 twin-turbo flat-six, 560 hp, variable-geometry turbos so the lift is moderate (1.3), AWD, PDK. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_cayenne.name: Porsche Cayenne Turbo S
ac:ks_porsche_cayenne.notes: 4.8 twin-turbo V8 at 570 hp in a 2.2 tonne SUV with an eight-speed automatic: soft rumble, everything damped. ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_cayman_gt4_clubsport.name: Porsche Cayman GT4 Clubsport
ac:ks_porsche_cayman_gt4_clubsport.notes: The GT4-class Clubsport: 3.8 flat-six at 385 hp, race exhaust (pops 0.8), stripped shell, PDK with race software (synchro-shaped). GT4 rules: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_porsche_cayman_gt4_std.name: Porsche Cayman GT4
ac:ks_porsche_cayman_gt4_std.notes: Road Cayman GT4: 3.8 flat-six, 385 hp, 7800 rpm, six-speed manual, mid-engined so the boxer is close behind you. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_macan.name: Porsche Macan Turbo
ac:ks_porsche_macan.notes: 3.6 twin-turbo V6 at 400 hp in a 1.9 tonne SUV, PDK: damped and quiet. ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_panamera.name: Porsche Panamera Turbo
ac:ks_porsche_panamera.notes: 2017 Panamera Turbo: 4.0 twin-turbo V8, 550 hp, two tonnes, eight-speed PDK: a soft V8 rumble through a lot of insulation. ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_718_boxster_s.name: Porsche 718 Boxster S
ac:ks_porsche_718_boxster_s.notes: 2.5 turbo flat-four, 350 hp, 7500 rpm: a boxer four is gruffer than the old six (thump 0.65, rock 0.55) with a turbo whoosh on lift (1.3). Six-speed manual. Road car: ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_718_boxster_s_pdk.name: Porsche 718 Boxster S PDK
ac:ks_porsche_718_boxster_s_pdk.notes: The PDK Boxster S: same engine, dual-clutch shifts (synchro shape, a touch of launch judder). ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_718_cayman_s.name: Porsche 718 Cayman S
ac:ks_porsche_718_cayman_s.notes: The coupe twin of the Boxster S: same 2.5 turbo flat-four and manual box. ABS and PSM on.

ac:ks_porsche_718_spyder_rs.name: Porsche 718 RS 60 Spyder
ac:ks_porsche_718_spyder_rs.notes: 1960 RS 60: 1.6 four-cam Fuhrmann flat-four on Webers, 160 hp, 7800 rpm, in a 550 kg spyder: the four-cam's rough carburetted idle (lope 0.55), heavy thump at 16 Hz, open exhaust. Five-speed Porsche synchro box with straight-cut gears (whine 0.6). 1960: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_porsche_908_lh.name: Porsche 908 LH
ac:ks_porsche_908_lh.notes: 1969 Le Mans long tail: 3.0 air-cooled flat-eight, 350 hp, 8400 rpm, mechanical injection, an engine with a flat-plane-like harshness and a lumpy idle (lope 0.45). Six-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1969: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_audi_r8_plus.name: Audi R8 V10 Plus
ac:ks_audi_r8_plus.notes: 5.2 NA V10, 610 hp, 8700 rpm, the Huracan's engine in the Audi: smooth ten with a loud overrun. Seven-speed S tronic DCT, quattro. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_audi_r8_lms_2016.name: Audi R8 LMS 2016
ac:ks_audi_r8_lms_2016.notes: Second-generation R8 LMS GT3: the 5.2 V10 and the X-trac six-speed sequential dog box. Values match the R8 LMS Ultra. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_audi_tt_cup.name: Audi TT Cup
ac:ks_audi_tt_cup.notes: One-make TT Cup: 2.0 TFSI at 310 hp with push-to-pass, stripped shell, race exhaust with blow-off and pop; six-speed S tronic DCT with race software. Cup car keeps ABS and TC.

ac:ks_audi_tt_vln.name: Audi TT RS (VLN)
ac:ks_audi_tt_vln.notes: VLN race TT RS: 2.5 turbo inline-five at 380 hp with the five-cylinder warble (thump 0.85 at 20 Hz), race exhaust bangs and a big dump on lift (1.7). Six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.8). VLN SP class: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_lotus_3_eleven.name: Lotus 3-Eleven
ac:ks_lotus_3_eleven.notes: Race-spec 3-Eleven: supercharged 3.5 V6 at 460 hp in 900 kg with no roof or screen, race exhaust (pops 0.7). Xtrac six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.7). Lotus fitted ABS and TC to the race car: both on.

ac:ks_maserati_mc12_gt1.name: Maserati MC12 GT1
ac:ks_maserati_mc12_gt1.notes: FIA GT1 MC12: the Enzo's 6.0 V12 at about 630 hp restricted, 7500 rpm, race exhaust that cracks (0.8). Six-speed sequential dog box, straight cut (whine 0.9). GT1 of the mid-2000s ran ABS and TC: both on.

ac:ks_mclaren_570s.name: McLaren 570S
ac:ks_mclaren_570s.notes: M838TE 3.8 twin-turbo flat-plane V8, 570 hp, 8500 rpm: the 12C's engine with less lag (lift 1.3). Seven-speed DCT. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_mclaren_p1_gtr.name: McLaren P1™ GTR
ac:ks_mclaren_p1_gtr.notes: Track-only P1: 3.8 twin-turbo V8 at 800 hp plus 200 hp electric, 8500 rpm, open exhaust (pops 0.7), turbo dump (1.5). Seven-speed DCT with race software (synchro shape, a little whine). Track car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_ferrari_250_gto.name: Ferrari 250 GTO
ac:ks_ferrari_250_gto.notes: 1962 Colombo 3.0 V12 on six Webers, 300 hp, 7500 rpm: carburetted V12 lumpiness at idle (lope 0.45), a howl above, bangs on the overrun. Five-speed synchro box with a loud gear set (0.5) and live-axle lash. 1962: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_ferrari_288_gto.name: Ferrari GTO
ac:ks_ferrari_288_gto.notes: 1984 Group B homologation car: the F40's 2.9 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 in its first form, 400 hp, with even more lag (lift 1.7) and a lumpier idle. Five-speed gated manual with transaxle lash. 1984: no ABS, no TC.

ac:ks_ferrari_312_67.name: Ferrari 312/67
ac:ks_ferrari_312_67.notes: 1967 F1: 3.0 60-degree V12, 390 hp, 10000 rpm, Lucas mechanical injection and an uneven idle (lope 0.5), the scream above. Five-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1967: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_ferrari_330_p4.name: Ferrari 330 P4
ac:ks_ferrari_330_p4.notes: 1967 prototype: 4.0 three-valve V12 on Lucas injection, 450 hp, 8000 rpm, the Daytona 1-2-3 car: carburettor-era lumpiness at idle (lope 0.45), V12 howl, open exhaust bangs. Five-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1967: nothing electronic.

ac:ks_ferrari_812_superfast.name: Ferrari 812 Superfast
ac:ks_ferrari_812_superfast.notes: 6.5 NA V12, 800 hp, 8900 rpm, front-mid engine: the smoothest big V12 here, all buzz, a loud overrun (0.6). Seven-speed DCT transaxle. Road car: ABS and F1-Trac on.

ac:ks_ferrari_sf70h.name: Ferrari SF70H
ac:ks_ferrari_sf70h.notes: 2017 hybrid F1: the SF15-T's successor, 1.6 V6 turbo with MGU-H (no dump on lift), 15000 rpm, eight-speed seamless box. Values match the SF15-T. 2017 rules: no TC, no ABS.

ac:ks_alfa_giulia_qv.name: Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio
ac:ks_alfa_giulia_qv.notes: 2.9 twin-turbo 90-degree V6 (Ferrari-derived), 510 hp, 7000 rpm, with the Race-mode exhaust crackle (pops 0.5) and a decent blow-off (1.3). Eight-speed ZF automatic. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ac:ks_lamborghini_sesto_elemento.name: Lamborghini Sesto Elemento
ac:ks_lamborghini_sesto_elemento.notes: The Gallardo's 5.2 V10 at 570 hp in a 999 kg carbon track car with no sound deadening at all: loud overrun (0.8), everything closer than in the Gallardo. e-gear single-clutch, hard shifts (shunt 0.7). Track toy with road electronics: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_ford_mustang_2015.name: Ford Mustang 2015
ac:ks_ford_mustang_2015.notes: Coyote 5.0 cross-plane V8, 435 hp, 6500 rpm: the classic muscle lope (rock 0.8), heavy pulses at 16 Hz. Six-speed Getrag manual, synchro, some lash. Road car: ABS and AdvanceTrac on.

ac:ks_mclaren_p1.name: McLaren P1™
ac:ks_mclaren_p1.notes: 3.8 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at 737 hp plus 179 hp electric, 8500 rpm: the electric torque fill hides some of the lag but the turbos still dump (1.4). Seven-speed DCT. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_audi_r18_etron_quattro.name: Audi R18 e-tron quattro 2014
ac:ks_audi_r18_etron_quattro.notes: 2014 Le Mans winner: 4.0 TDI V6 single turbo at about 560 hp and only 4500 rpm, plus a flywheel-accumulator hybrid driving the fronts. A diesel: heavy low-frequency pulses (thump 0.9 at 16 Hz), hardly any top-end buzz, no overrun crackle, a muted lift (the turbo is tiny and the hybrid fills). Six-speed sequential dog box. TC yes (LMP1 ran it), no ABS.

ac:ks_ferrari_488_challenge_evo.name: Ferrari 488 Challenge Evo
ac:ks_ferrari_488_challenge_evo.notes: One-make Challenge Evo: the 488's 3.9 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at 670 hp, 8000 rpm, F1 DCT with race shift maps (quick, hard shifts: dog shape). Flat-plane scream (buzz 0.9) with turbo flutter on lift (1.5) and a race exhaust that pops. Challenge cars keep ABS and F1-Trac TC.

ac:ks_ferrari_488_gt3_2020.name: Ferrari 488 GT3 Evo 2020
ac:ks_ferrari_488_gt3_2020.notes: 488 GT3 Evo 2020: same 3.9 twin-turbo V8 BoP'd to about 550 hp, Hewland six-speed sequential (straight-cut, whine 0.8). Same values as the 488 GT3 with the Evo's firmer shift. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ac:ks_porsche_911_rsr_2017.name: Porsche 911 RSR 2017
ac:ks_porsche_911_rsr_2017.notes: The mid-engined GTE RSR: 4.0 NA flat-six at 510 hp, 9300 rpm, six-speed sequential straight-cut dog box (whine 0.9) with the engine ahead of the axle for the first time. A wailing boxer with heavy pops on the overrun. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Formula Classic Gen1 Model1.name: Formula Classic Gen1 Model1
ams2:Formula Classic Gen1 Model1.notes: 1986-style 1.5 V6 twin-turbo at 1190 hp (wiki: based on the Williams FW11, i.e. the Honda RA166E), 5-speed dogleg H-pattern, 620 kg. Same engine class as the Lotus 98T: tiny engine, instant revs, huge lag and dump (lift-off 2.0), 4 bar boost saturates the boost hit, brutal cut. Straight-cut dog box (whine 1.0), heavy shunt from the boost surge. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen1 Model2.name: Formula Classic Gen1 Model2
ams2:Formula Classic Gen1 Model2.notes: 1986-style 1.5 inline-four turbo at 1300 hp (wiki: Arrows A9 with a Lola THL2 front, i.e. the BMW M12/13 four-cylinder). A big-bore four at 1300 hp shakes far more than the V6 (rock 0.7, thump 0.7, lope 0.4); same lag and dump, same dog box. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Lotus 98T.name: Lotus 98T
ams2:Lotus 98T.notes: Same car as the AC entry: Renault EF15B 1.5 V6 twin-turbo, 12000 rpm, 4 bar race boost. Values copied from the AC table. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model1.name: Formula Classic Gen2 Model1
ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model1.notes: 1988-89 style 3.5 NA V8 at 626 hp (Cosworth DFR class), 6-speed H-pattern, 610 kg. Flat-plane race V8: scream with a little lumpiness at the mechanical-injection idle, instant revs, overrun crackle. Straight-cut dog box. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model2.name: Formula Classic Gen2 Model2
ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model2.notes: 1988-89 style 3.5 NA V8 at 662 hp (Judd class), 6-speed H-pattern, 610 kg. As Model1 with a little more top end. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model3.name: Formula Classic Gen2 Model3
ams2:Formula Classic Gen2 Model3.notes: 1988-style 1.5 V6 twin-turbo at 675 hp with the pop-off valve (2.5 bar limit), 6-speed H-pattern, 620 kg: the 1986 engine tamed, so less lag and dump than Gen1 (lift-off 1.7). No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:McLaren MP4/4.name: McLaren MP4/4
ams2:McLaren MP4/4.notes: 1988 Honda RA168E 1.5 80-degree V6 twin-turbo, about 680 hp at 2.5 bar, 12500 rpm, 6-speed H-pattern. The tidiest of the turbo-era engines (Honda's management), so slightly less lope than the generic Gen2 Model3. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model1.name: Formula Classic Gen3 Model1
ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model1.notes: 1990-style 3.5 NA V12 at 725 hp (Ferrari 641 class), 6-speed H-pattern (the wiki gives H-shifter, so the semi-auto is not modelled here), 620 kg. Twelve cylinders: smoothest idle of the generation, pure scream above, big downshift bark. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model2.name: Formula Classic Gen3 Model2
ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model2.notes: 1990-style 3.5 NA V8 at 632 hp with a 6-speed sequential on paddles (wiki), 610 kg. Flat-plane V8 scream; the semi-auto shifts faster so the shunt is a touch smaller. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model3.name: Formula Classic Gen3 Model3
ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model3.notes: 1990-style 3.5 NA V10 at 734 hp (Honda RA100E / Renault RS2 class), 6-speed H-pattern, 610 kg. The most powerful of the generation; V10 scream sits between the V8's edge and the V12's smoothness. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model4.name: Formula Classic Gen3 Model4
ams2:Formula Classic Gen3 Model4.notes: 1990-style 3.5 NA V8 at 661 hp (Ford HB class) in the lightest chassis of the generation (585 kg), 6-speed H-pattern. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:McLaren MP4/5B.name: McLaren MP4/5B
ams2:McLaren MP4/5B.notes: 1990 Honda RA100E 3.5 72-degree V10, about 690 hp, 13000 rpm, 6-speed H-pattern. Matches Gen3 Model3. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model1.name: Formula Classic Gen4 Model1
ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model1.notes: 1991-style 3.5 NA V12 at 726 hp with a 7-speed sequential on paddles (Ferrari 643 class), 620 kg. V12 scream, fast semi-auto shifts (smaller shunt). No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model2.name: Formula Classic Gen4 Model2
ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model2.notes: 1991-style 3.5 NA V10 at 707 hp with a 6-speed sequential on paddles (Williams FW14 Renault class), 610 kg. No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model3.name: Formula Classic Gen4 Model3
ams2:Formula Classic Gen4 Model3.notes: 1991-style 3.5 NA V8 at 662 hp, 6-speed H-pattern, 585 kg (Jordan 191 Ford HB class). No ABS, no TC (wiki).

ams2:McLaren MP4/6.name: McLaren MP4/6
ams2:McLaren MP4/6.notes: 1991 Honda RA121E 3.5 60-degree V12, about 735 hp, 13500 rpm, the last F1 championship won with an H-pattern manual (6-speed). V12 scream. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model1.name: Formula HiTech Gen1 Model1
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model1.notes: 1992-style active-era 3.5 V12 at 727 hp, 7-speed sequential (Ferrari F92A class), 610 kg. Wiki: traction control yes, ABS no. The TC cut is period-correct (the 1992 cars ran it). V12 scream, fast shifts.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model2.name: Formula HiTech Gen1 Model2
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model2.notes: 1992-style 3.5 V10 at 707 hp, 6-speed sequential, 585 kg (Williams FW14B Renault class, the active-suspension car). Wiki: TC yes, ABS no.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model3.name: Formula HiTech Gen1 Model3
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model3.notes: 1992-style 3.5 V8 at 662 hp with a 6-speed H-pattern, 585 kg: the privateer end of the grid (Ford HB customer engine, manual box). Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model4.name: Formula HiTech Gen1 Model4
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen1 Model4.notes: 1992-style 3.5 V10 at 707 hp, 6-speed sequential, 585 kg, without the electronics (Ligier/Honda customer class). Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:McLaren MP4/7A.name: McLaren MP4/7A
ams2:McLaren MP4/7A.notes: 1992 Honda RA122E/B 3.5 75-degree V12, about 750 hp, 14000 rpm, McLaren's first semi-auto 6-speed, fly-by-wire throttle and traction control. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model1.name: Formula HiTech Gen2 Model1
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model1.notes: 1993-style 3.5 V12 at 727 hp, 6-speed sequential, 610 kg, the full gadget year (Ferrari F93A class). Wiki: TC yes, ABS yes, so both tiles are live on this car.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model2.name: Formula HiTech Gen2 Model2
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model2.notes: 1993-style 3.5 V10 at 707 hp, 6-speed sequential, 585 kg (Williams FW15C class: active suspension, TC, ABS). Wiki: TC yes, ABS yes.

ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model3.name: Formula HiTech Gen2 Model3
ams2:Formula HiTech Gen2 Model3.notes: 1993-style 3.5 V8 at 662 hp, 6-speed sequential, 585 kg (Benetton B193 Ford HB class). Wiki: TC yes, ABS yes.

ams2:McLaren MP4/8.name: McLaren MP4/8
ams2:McLaren MP4/8.notes: 1993 Ford HBE7 3.5 V8 customer engine, about 700 hp, 13000 rpm, 6-speed semi-auto, active suspension and traction control (Senna's Donington car). TC on; McLaren did not run ABS in 1993, so ABS off.

ams2:Formula Edge Model1.name: Formula Edge Model1
ams2:Formula Edge Model1.notes: 1995-style 3.0 NA V12 at 660 hp (wiki: Ferrari 412 T2, the last F1 V12), 6-speed sequential, 595 kg, 17000 rpm. The smoothest scream of the lot, no inertia. No TC (banned 1994), no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Edge Model2.name: Formula Edge Model2
ams2:Formula Edge Model2.notes: 1995-style 3.0 NA V10 at 650 hp (Renault RS7 class), 7-speed sequential on paddles, 595 kg. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Edge Model3.name: Formula Edge Model3
ams2:Formula Edge Model3.notes: 1995-style 3.0 NA V8 at 620 hp (Ford Zetec-R class), 6-speed sequential on paddles, 595 kg. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula V10 Gen1.name: Formula V10 Gen1
ams2:Formula V10 Gen1.notes: 1997-style 3.0 V10, about 750 hp, 16500 rpm, 6-speed semi-auto. The V10 scream and the downshift bark of the late 1990s (pops 0.9). No TC (banned 1994 to 2001), no ABS.

ams2:McLaren MP4/12.name: McLaren MP4/12
ams2:McLaren MP4/12.notes: 1997 Mercedes-Ilmor FO110E 3.0 72-degree V10, about 750 hp, 16500 rpm, 6-speed semi-auto. Matches Formula V10 Gen1. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula V10 Gen2 (B).name: Formula V10 Gen2 (B)
ams2:Formula V10 Gen2 (B).notes: 2000-01 style 3.0 V10 at 816 hp (wiki: Williams FW23 BMW), 7-speed sequential, 600 kg, 18000 rpm. Wiki: TC yes (traction control was re-legalised in 2001), ABS no. (B) and (M) are two body styles of the same car.

ams2:Formula V10 Gen2 (M).name: Formula V10 Gen2 (M)
ams2:Formula V10 Gen2 (M).notes: Same spec as Formula V10 Gen2 (B): 3.0 V10, 816 hp, 7-speed sequential, 600 kg. Wiki: TC yes, ABS no.

ams2:Formula V10 Gen3 (B).name: Formula V10 Gen3 (B)
ams2:Formula V10 Gen3 (B).notes: 2004-05 style 3.0 V10, about 900 hp, 19000 rpm, 7-speed seamless-ish semi-auto: the peak of the V10 era (the F2004 is the AC twin). TC legal until 2007: on. No ABS.

ams2:Formula V10 Gen3 (M).name: Formula V10 Gen3 (M)
ams2:Formula V10 Gen3 (M).notes: Same spec as Formula V10 Gen3 (B). TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Renault R25.name: Renault R25
ams2:Renault R25.notes: 2005 champion: Renault RS25 3.0 72-degree V10, about 900 hp, 19000 rpm, 7-speed semi-auto. Matches V10 Gen3. TC on (legal in 2005), no ABS.

ams2:Formula V8 Gen1 (B).name: Formula V8 Gen1 (B)
ams2:Formula V8 Gen1 (B).notes: 2006-07 style 2.4 V8, about 750 hp, 19000 rpm, 7-speed seamless semi-auto. The V8s scream even higher than the V10s. TC legal until the end of 2007: on. No ABS.

ams2:Formula V8 Gen1 (M).name: Formula V8 Gen1 (M)
ams2:Formula V8 Gen1 (M).notes: Same spec as Formula V8 Gen1 (B). TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Renault R26.name: Renault R26
ams2:Renault R26.notes: 2006 champion: Renault RS26 2.4 90-degree V8, about 750 hp, 19000 rpm, 7-speed seamless. TC on (2006), no ABS.

ams2:Formula V8 Gen2.name: Formula V8 Gen2
ams2:Formula V8 Gen2.notes: 2008 style 2.4 V8 at the 19000 rpm cap, 7-speed seamless, no driver aids: the standard ECU banned TC from 2008. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Renault R28.name: Renault R28
ams2:Renault R28.notes: 2008 Renault RS27 2.4 V8, 19000 rpm, 7-speed seamless. Matches V8 Gen2. No TC (2008 ban), no ABS.

ams2:Formula Reiza.name: Formula Reiza
ams2:Formula Reiza.notes: 2009-13 style 2.4 V8 at 754 hp with the 18000 rpm cap of those years (wiki: Red Bull RB6/RB9 basis), 7-speed sequential on paddles, 620 kg. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen1.name: Formula Ultimate Gen1
ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen1.notes: Hybrid-era 1.6 V6 turbo with MGU-H and MGU-K, 960 hp combined (wiki), 8-speed sequential, 15000 rpm. The MGU-H spins the turbo so there is no dump on lift (1.0, turbo on for the boost hit only) and the exhaust is muted (pops 0.4). No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen2.name: Formula Ultimate Gen2
ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen2.notes: The wide-body hybrid generation (2017-21 style): same power unit character as Gen1. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen3.name: Formula Ultimate Gen3
ams2:Formula Ultimate Gen3.notes: The ground-effect generation (2022 on): same power unit character, heavier car. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula USA 2023.name: Formula USA 2023
ams2:Formula USA 2023.notes: IndyCar-style 2.2 twin-turbo V6, 700 hp (push-to-pass more), 12000 rpm, 6-speed sequential on paddles. Real turbos with a wastegate: a proper whoosh on lift (1.5). IndyCar runs no TC and no ABS.

ams2:Brabham BT44.name: Brabham BT44
ams2:Brabham BT44.notes: 1974-75 Cosworth DFV 3.0 flat-plane V8, about 465 hp, 10500 rpm, stressed-member engine behind your back: rock 0.6, thump 0.8, rough mechanical-injection idle (lope 0.45). Hewland FG400 5-speed straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0. 1974: nothing electronic.

ams2:Formula Retro V12.name: Formula Retro V12
ams2:Formula Retro V12.notes: 1974-75 style 3.0 NA V12 at 516 hp (wiki: Shadow DN3 basis), 5-speed dogleg H-pattern, 670 kg. The twelve howls where the DFV barks; a touch smoother at idle. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Retro V8.name: Formula Retro V8
ams2:Formula Retro V8.notes: 1974-75 style Cosworth DFV 3.0 V8 car, the privateer's engine: matches the BT44. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lotus Type 72E.name: Lotus Type 72E
ams2:Lotus Type 72E.notes: 1973 Lotus 72E: DFV V8, Hewland 5-speed; the same values as the AC Lotus 72D. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:McLaren M23.name: McLaren M23
ams2:McLaren M23.notes: 1973-76 McLaren M23: DFV V8, Hewland 5 or 6-speed dog box; the 1974 and 1976 champion. DFV values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Brabham BT46B.name: Brabham BT46B
ams2:Brabham BT46B.notes: 1978 fan car: Alfa Romeo 115-12 3.0 flat-12, about 520 hp, 12000 rpm; the boxer twelve howls like the 312T's. 6-speed straight-cut dog box. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Brabham BT49.name: Brabham BT49
ams2:Brabham BT49.notes: 1979-81 BT49: DFV V8 at about 500 hp, 11000 rpm, the 1981 champion. Brabham/Alfa or Hewland 6-speed dog box. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Retro Gen2.name: Formula Retro Gen2
ams2:Formula Retro Gen2.notes: 1978-80 style ground-effect DFV car (Williams FW07 class). DFV values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lotus 79.name: Lotus 79
ams2:Lotus 79.notes: 1978 champion, the first full ground-effect car: DFV V8, Hewland 5-speed. DFV values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Brabham BT52.name: Brabham BT52
ams2:Brabham BT52.notes: 1983 champion: BMW M12/13 1.5 inline-four turbo, about 640 hp in race trim and over 1000 in qualifying, 11000 rpm, from a production block. A big four at that boost shakes hard (rock 0.7, thump 0.75, lope 0.45) and the single huge KKK turbo has the worst lag and dump of the era (lift-off 2.0, shunt 0.85 as the boost lands). 5-speed Hewland/Weismann straight-cut dog box. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Retro Gen3 DFY.name: Formula Retro Gen3 DFY
ams2:Formula Retro Gen3 DFY.notes: 1983 style Cosworth DFY (the short-stroke DFV, about 520 hp, 11000 rpm) in a flat-bottom car (Tyrrell 012 class), 5-speed dog box. The last of the DFV family against the turbos. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Retro Gen3 Turbo.name: Formula Retro Gen3 Turbo
ams2:Formula Retro Gen3 Turbo.notes: 1983 style 1.5 V6 twin-turbo at 830 hp (wiki: Arrows A6 basis), 5-speed dogleg H-pattern, 650 kg. Early turbo era: lag, dump (2.0) and boost-surge shunt. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:McLaren MP4/1C.name: McLaren MP4/1C
ams2:McLaren MP4/1C.notes: 1983 MP4/1C: the carbon McLaren with the Cosworth DFY V8 (its last DFV-family car before the TAG turbo), Hewland 5-speed. DFY values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vintage Gen1 Model1.name: Formula Vintage Gen1 Model1
ams2:Formula Vintage Gen1 Model1.notes: 1967 style DFV V8 at about 400 hp (wiki: Lotus 49 basis, 299 kW), 5-speed dogleg, 595 kg: the first DFV, same values as the AC Lotus 49. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Vintage Gen1 Model2.name: Formula Vintage Gen1 Model2
ams2:Formula Vintage Gen1 Model2.notes: 1967 style 3.0 V12 at 411 hp (wiki: Eagle Mk1 Weslake), 5-speed dogleg, 630 kg: the sweetest-sounding V12 of its day, carburettor-era idle. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Brabham BT26A.name: Brabham BT26A
ams2:Brabham BT26A.notes: 1969 BT26A: the Repco car re-engined with a Cosworth DFV, Hewland DG300 5-speed. DFV values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vintage Gen2 Model1.name: Formula Vintage Gen2 Model1
ams2:Formula Vintage Gen2 Model1.notes: 1969-70 style DFV V8 car with wings (Matra MS80 / McLaren M7 class), 5-speed dogleg. DFV values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vintage Gen2 Model2.name: Formula Vintage Gen2 Model2
ams2:Formula Vintage Gen2 Model2.notes: 1969-70 style 3.0 V12 at 428 hp (wiki), 5-speed dogleg, 630 kg (Matra V12 / Ferrari 312 class). No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Lotus Type 49C.name: Lotus Type 49C
ams2:Lotus Type 49C.notes: 1970 Lotus 49C: the 49 with wings and the DFV at 430 hp, Hewland DG300 5-speed. Same values as the AC Lotus 49. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vee.name: Formula Vee
ams2:Formula Vee.notes: Brazilian Formula Vee: VW EA111 1.6 four (wiki, 93 hp) hung off the back of a 530 kg spaceframe with VW Beetle running gear: a small four with nothing between it and you (rock 0.8, thump 0.8, lope 0.4). Beetle 4-speed with swing-axle lash (shunt 0.7) and gear noise. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vee Fin.name: Formula Vee Fin
ams2:Formula Vee Fin.notes: The Gen1 Vee with the engine-cover fin: identical mechanicals. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Vee Gen2.name: Formula Vee Gen2
ams2:Formula Vee Gen2.notes: Current-generation Brazilian Vee: the same VW 1.6 four and Beetle transaxle in a newer chassis. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Trainer.name: Formula Trainer
ams2:Formula Trainer.notes: Formula Ford style trainer (wiki: Mygale SJ08 basis): 1.6 four at 113 hp, 4-speed sequential dog box, 495 kg, engine solidly mounted behind you. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Formula Trainer Advanced.name: Formula Trainer Advanced
ams2:Formula Trainer Advanced.notes: The winged version of the trainer with more power and a closer-ratio sequential: a step towards F4. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Junior.name: Formula Junior
ams2:Formula Junior.notes: Early-1960s Formula Junior (Lotus 22 class): 1.0 Ford pushrod four on Webers at 126 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern (Hewland Mk gearbox with straight-cut gears, whine 0.6), 483 kg: a buzzy little four with a carburettor idle. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Dirt.name: Formula Dirt
ams2:Formula Dirt.notes: Brazilian dirt-track formula: 1.8 air-cooled VW flat-four at 84 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 725 kg. The Beetle boxer shakes the whole frame at idle (rock 0.9, thump 0.85 at 16 Hz). No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Formula Inter MG15.name: Formula Inter MG15
ams2:Formula Inter MG15.notes: Brazilian Fórmula Inter MG15: Ford Duratec 2.0 four at 161 hp (wiki), 5-speed dogleg H-pattern with a race gear set (whine 0.5), 615 kg. Name in the roster carries an accent (Fórmula Inter MG15); the wiki page uses Formula Inter MG-15. Confirm the string the sim sends. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Dallara F301.name: Dallara F301
ams2:Dallara F301.notes: Dallara F301 Formula 3 (Brazilian series): 2.0 four at about 210 hp with the F3 air restrictor, 6-speed Hewland sequential dog box (whine 0.9). The in-game name is just F301 (wiki roster). No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Dallara F309.name: Dallara F309
ams2:Dallara F309.notes: Dallara F309 Formula 3: 2.3 four at 260 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential, 560 kg. In-game name F309. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Lola T95/00 Ford-Cosworth.name: Lola T95/00 Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Lola T95/00 Ford-Cosworth.notes: 1995 CART: Cosworth XB 2.65 V8 single-turbo on methanol, about 800 hp, 13500 rpm, pop-off valve. A single turbo with a wastegate gives a clear but not brutal whoosh on lift (1.4); the V8 screams. Xtrac 6-speed sequential lever, straight cut. CART: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola T95/00 Mercedes-Benz.name: Lola T95/00 Mercedes-Benz
ams2:Lola T95/00 Mercedes-Benz.notes: 1995 CART: Mercedes-Ilmor IC108B 2.65 V8 turbo. Same class values as the Cosworth car. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 95i Ford-Cosworth.name: Reynard 95i Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Reynard 95i Ford-Cosworth.notes: 1995 CART Reynard with the Cosworth XB. Class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 95i Honda.name: Reynard 95i Honda
ams2:Reynard 95i Honda.notes: 1995 CART Reynard with the Honda HRH V8 turbo. Class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 95i Mercedes-Benz.name: Reynard 95i Mercedes-Benz
ams2:Reynard 95i Mercedes-Benz.notes: 1995 CART Reynard with the Mercedes-Ilmor V8 turbo. Class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola T98/00 Ford-Cosworth.name: Lola T98/00 Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Lola T98/00 Ford-Cosworth.notes: 1998 CART: Cosworth XD 2.65 V8 turbo, about 850 hp, 14500 rpm. Gen 2 revs higher than 1995 (carrier up). No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 98i Ford-Cosworth.name: Reynard 98i Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Reynard 98i Ford-Cosworth.notes: 1998 CART Reynard with the Cosworth XD. Gen 2 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 98i Honda.name: Reynard 98i Honda
ams2:Reynard 98i Honda.notes: 1998 CART Reynard with the Honda HRK V8 turbo, the dominant package of the year. Gen 2 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 98i Mercedes-Benz.name: Reynard 98i Mercedes-Benz
ams2:Reynard 98i Mercedes-Benz.notes: 1998 CART Reynard with the Mercedes-Ilmor IC108E. Gen 2 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 98i Toyota.name: Reynard 98i Toyota
ams2:Reynard 98i Toyota.notes: 1998 CART Reynard with the Toyota RV8C. Gen 2 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Swift 009c Ford-Cosworth.name: Swift 009c Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Swift 009c Ford-Cosworth.notes: 1998 CART Swift (Newman/Haas) with the Cosworth XD. Gen 2 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola B2K/00 Ford-Cosworth.name: Lola B2K/00 Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Lola B2K/00 Ford-Cosworth.notes: 2000 CART: Cosworth XF 2.65 V8 turbo, about 900 hp, 15000 rpm. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola B2K/00 Mercedes-Benz.name: Lola B2K/00 Mercedes-Benz
ams2:Lola B2K/00 Mercedes-Benz.notes: 2000 CART Lola with the Mercedes-Ilmor IC108F. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola B2K/00 Toyota.name: Lola B2K/00 Toyota
ams2:Lola B2K/00 Toyota.notes: 2000 CART Lola with the Toyota RV8D. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 2Ki Ford-Cosworth.name: Reynard 2Ki Ford-Cosworth
ams2:Reynard 2Ki Ford-Cosworth.notes: 2000 CART Reynard with the Cosworth XF. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 2Ki Honda.name: Reynard 2Ki Honda
ams2:Reynard 2Ki Honda.notes: 2000 CART Reynard with the Honda HRK. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 2Ki Mercedes-Benz.name: Reynard 2Ki Mercedes-Benz
ams2:Reynard 2Ki Mercedes-Benz.notes: 2000 CART Reynard with the Mercedes-Ilmor IC108F. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Reynard 2Ki Toyota.name: Reynard 2Ki Toyota
ams2:Reynard 2Ki Toyota.notes: 2000 CART Reynard with the Toyota RV8D. Gen 3 class values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Chevrolet Chevette.name: Chevrolet Chevette
ams2:Chevrolet Chevette.notes: Copa Classic B: 1.6 GM pushrod four on a carburettor, about 120 hp, in a light 1980s saloon with solid mounts: lumpy idle (lope 0.35), buzzy four, live-axle lash. 4 or 5-speed H-pattern. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Uno Classic B.name: Uno Classic B
ams2:Uno Classic B.notes: Copa Classic B Uno: 1.6 Fiat four, about 120 hp, carburetted, front-drive hatch with a 5-speed H-pattern. Nothing electronic.

ams2:MINI Cooper S 1965.name: MINI Cooper S 1965
ams2:MINI Cooper S 1965.notes: 1965 Cooper S in the Copa Classic B: 1275 A-series four on twin SUs, about 100 hp race trim, the gearbox in the sump sharing the engine oil (constant gear whine, 0.5), 4-speed H-pattern, front-driven, rubber-cone suspension transmitting everything. Nothing electronic.

ams2:MINI Cooper S 1965 B.name: MINI Cooper S 1965 B
ams2:MINI Cooper S 1965 B.notes: The 1965 Cooper S under the second name the sim gives it (a B after the year). Same values as the MINI Cooper S 1965: the 1275 A-series four on twin SUs, gearbox-in-sump whine (0.5), 4-speed H-pattern, front-driven. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Puma GTE.name: Puma GTE
ams2:Puma GTE.notes: Copa Classic B Puma GTE: the Brazilian fibreglass coupe on VW Beetle mechanicals, 1.6 air-cooled flat-four behind the rear axle, 4-speed Beetle box with swing-axle lash. The boxer thumps through the glass body. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Gol Classic B.name: Gol Classic B
ams2:Gol Classic B.notes: Copa Classic B Gol: VW AP 1.6 four at 120 hp (wiki), 5-speed H-pattern, 880 kg. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Passat Classic B.name: Passat Classic B
ams2:Passat Classic B.notes: Copa Classic B Passat (the Brazilian Mk1): VW AP 1.6 four, about 120 hp, 4 or 5-speed H-pattern. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Puma GTB.name: Puma GTB
ams2:Puma GTB.notes: Copa Classic FL Puma GTB: the front-engined Puma with the Chevrolet Opala 4.1 inline-six, a lazy big six with heavy pulses (16 Hz) and a long stroke (inertia 0.65), 4-speed H-pattern, live axle. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Fusca Classic FL.name: Fusca Classic FL
ams2:Fusca Classic FL.notes: Copa Classic FL Fusca: 1.8 air-cooled flat-four at 165 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 840 kg. A Beetle boxer at race tune shakes the shell at idle (rock 0.9, thump 0.85). Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Gol Classic FL.name: Gol Classic FL
ams2:Gol Classic FL.notes: Copa Classic FL Gol: VW AP 2.0 four at 173 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 880 kg. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Passat Classic FL.name: Passat Classic FL
ams2:Passat Classic FL.notes: Copa Classic FL Passat: VW AP 2.0 four, about 170 hp, 4-speed H-pattern. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Copa Fusca.name: Copa Fusca
ams2:Copa Fusca.notes: Copa Fusca: the 1.6 air-cooled Beetle at 123 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 830 kg. Boxer idle shake, swing-axle lash. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Copa Montana.name: Copa Montana
ams2:Copa Montana.notes: Copa Montana: a pickup silhouette on a tube frame with a 5.7 Chevrolet V8 at 369 hp (wiki), 5-speed sequential, 1360 kg. Big cross-plane V8 lope and heavy pulses (16 Hz), straight-cut sequential. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Copa Uno.name: Copa Uno
ams2:Copa Uno.notes: Copa Uno: 1.6 four at 131 hp (wiki), 5-speed sequential stick with straight-cut gears (whine 0.6), 860 kg. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:IVECO Stralis.name: IVECO Stralis
ams2:IVECO Stralis.notes: Copa Truck: 12.9 litre inline-six turbo diesel at about 1200 hp and 3700 Nm, redline around 2500 rpm (the Engine tile learns it). A race diesel is all thump: the firing cadence is slow and heavy (carrier 10 Hz, thump 1.0, rock 0.9), huge inertia, the turbo sighs on lift and the compression brake rumbles on the overrun. 5+1 H-pattern (wiki), enormous driveline shunt and lugging at 3 Hz. No TC, no ABS (wiki, for the class).

ams2:MAN TGX.name: MAN TGX
ams2:MAN TGX.notes: Copa Truck: 12.4 inline-six turbo diesel, 1210 hp, 3700 Nm, 5+1 H-pattern, 4820 kg (wiki). Truck diesel values as the Stralis. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Mercedes-Benz Actros-2651.name: Mercedes-Benz Actros-2651
ams2:Mercedes-Benz Actros-2651.notes: Copa Truck: OM 471 12.8 inline-six turbo diesel at the series' 1200 hp. Truck diesel values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Vulkan Truck.name: Vulkan Truck
ams2:Vulkan Truck.notes: Copa Truck: the fictional-brand truck on the same spec (inline-six turbo diesel, about 1200 hp). Truck diesel values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Volkswagen Constellation.name: Volkswagen Constellation
ams2:Volkswagen Constellation.notes: Copa Truck: VW Constellation on the series spec (inline-six turbo diesel, about 1200 hp). Truck diesel values. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Fusca 1 Hot Cars.name: Fusca 1 Hot Cars
ams2:Fusca 1 Hot Cars.notes: Hot Cars (Divisão 3) Fusca 1: tuned 1.6 air-cooled boxer around 150 hp, open exhaust, 4-speed H-pattern, stripped 760 kg shell. The in-game name may read Volkswagen Fusca HC1 (the wiki infobox) rather than the roster's 'Fusca 1 Hot Cars': confirm. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Fusca 2 Hot Cars.name: Fusca 2 Hot Cars
ams2:Fusca 2 Hot Cars.notes: Hot Cars Fusca 2: 1.6 boxer at 160 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 760 kg. Wiki infobox name: Volkswagen Fusca HC2 (confirm against the sim). Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Gol Hot Cars.name: Gol Hot Cars
ams2:Gol Hot Cars.notes: Hot Cars Gol: VW AP 1.8 four around 165 hp, 4-speed H-pattern, light shell. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Passat Hot Cars.name: Passat Hot Cars
ams2:Passat Hot Cars.notes: Hot Cars Passat: VW AP 1.8 four at 165 hp (wiki), 4-speed H-pattern, 785 kg. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Sprint Race.name: Sprint Race
ams2:Sprint Race.notes: Brazilian Sprint Race spec car: 3.0 V6 at 265 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential dog box, 940 kg tube-frame silhouette. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer R.name: Mitsubishi Lancer R
ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer R.notes: Lancer Cup R: 2.0 4B11 turbo four, about 300 hp, AWD, 5-speed H-pattern manual (the RS adds aero and a sequential, per the wiki). Turbo blow-off (1.3). Cup car keeps ABS and TC (wiki for the RS; same car).

ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer RS.name: Mitsubishi Lancer RS
ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer RS.notes: Lancer Cup RS: 2.0 turbo four at 301 hp, 6-speed sequential, AWD, 1490 kg; TC yes, ABS yes (wiki). Sequential with a race gear set (whine 0.5).

ams2:Volkswagen Polo.name: Volkswagen Polo
ams2:Volkswagen Polo.notes: TSI Cup Polo: the 1.0 200 TSI three-cylinder turbo (128 hp), six-speed automatic. A triple has an odd-fire rock the fours lack (rock 0.7 at a low carrier), with a small turbo. The wiki infobox calls the engine I4; the production 200 TSI is a three, which is what the model uses. ABS and TC on (wiki).

ams2:Volkswagen Polo GTS.name: Volkswagen Polo GTS
ams2:Volkswagen Polo GTS.notes: TSI Cup Polo GTS: 1.4 TSI four at about 150 hp, six-speed automatic, 1299 kg. ABS and TC on (wiki).

ams2:Volkswagen Virtus.name: Volkswagen Virtus
ams2:Volkswagen Virtus.notes: TSI Cup Virtus saloon: the Polo's 1.0 three-cylinder turbo and automatic. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Volkswagen Virtus GTS.name: Volkswagen Virtus GTS
ams2:Volkswagen Virtus GTS.notes: TSI Cup Virtus GTS: the 1.4 TSI four and automatic. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Opala Old Stock Race.name: Chevrolet Opala Old Stock Race
ams2:Chevrolet Opala Old Stock Race.notes: Old Stock Race Opala: the Chevrolet 4.1 (250) inline-six on carburettors at 293 hp (wiki), 5-speed H-pattern, 1200 kg.
