acevo:ks_bmw_m8_competition.notes: F92 M8 Competition Coupe: S63 4.4 twin-turbo V8 at 625 PS, eight-speed M Steptronic, M xDrive (BMW). Road car: ABS and DSC. Starting point: ac:ks_maserati_quattroporte (twin-turbo V8 on an automatic), firmer for the coupe.

acevo:ks_caterham_485_csr.name: Caterham 485 CSR
acevo:ks_caterham_485_csr.notes: Seven 485 CSR: 2.0 Ford Duratec inline-four NA at 240 PS, six-speed manual, rear-drive, independent rear (Caterham); Road, Track and Final Edition variants. No ABS, no TC. Starting point: ams2:Caterham Superlight (same Duratec family, H-pattern), more buzz and a harder cut for the 485's 8500 rpm tune.

acevo:ks_chevrolet_camaro_zl1.name: Chevrolet Camaro ZL1
acevo:ks_chevrolet_camaro_zl1.notes: Sixth-generation ZL1: LT4 6.2 supercharged V8 at 650 hp, six-speed manual (the 1LE is manual only), rear-drive (Chevrolet). Supercharged, so the turbo flag stays off and the blower's bypass sigh is the lift-off. Road car: ABS and TC. Starting point: ams2:Chevrolet Camaro SS (same LT family V8 and box).

acevo:ks_dallara_stradale_coupe.name: Dallara Stradale
acevo:ks_dallara_stradale_coupe.notes: 2.3 Ford EcoBoost inline-four turbo, Bosch-calibrated, 400 PS, carbon tub, six-speed manual or robotised paddle box, rear-drive (Dallara); Coupe, Spider and Track variants. EU type-approved road car: ABS and ESC. Starting point: ac:ktm_xbow_r (turbo four bolted behind you in a carbon tub, road synchro box).

acevo:ks_ferrari_296_gtb.name: Ferrari 296 GTB
acevo:ks_ferrari_296_gtb.notes: 3.0 120-degree twin-turbo V6 plus a rear e-motor, 830 CV combined, eight-speed DCT, rear-drive (Ferrari). Road car: ABS and F1-Trac. Starting point: ac:ks_ferrari_488_gtb (Ferrari twin-turbo on a DCT), buzz up for the V6's high-pitched note.

acevo:ks_ferrari_daytona_sp3.name: Ferrari Daytona SP3
acevo:ks_ferrari_daytona_sp3.notes: F140HC 6.5 V12 NA at 840 CV, 9500 rpm, mid-engined, seven-speed DCT, rear-drive (Ferrari). Road car: ABS and F1-Trac. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_ferrari_812_superfast (same F140 family V12 and DCT).

acevo:ks_hyundai_i30_n_hb.name: Hyundai i30 N Hatchback
acevo:ks_hyundai_i30_n_hb.notes: i30 N Performance: 2.0 T-GDi inline-four turbo at 280 PS, six-speed manual (the Drive-N Limited Edition variant has the eight-speed N DCT), front-drive with an e-LSD (Hyundai). Road car: ABS and ESC. Starting point: ams2:MINI Cooper JCW (2.0 turbo hot hatch on a manual), pops up for the N exhaust.

acevo:ks_lamborghini_huracan_sto.name: Lamborghini Huracan STO
acevo:ks_lamborghini_huracan_sto.notes: 5.2 V10 NA at 640 CV, 8000 rpm, seven-speed DCT, rear-drive (Lamborghini). Road car: ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_performante (same engine and box). Name kept unaccented (Huracan) so it matches SimHub's string.

acevo:ks_lotus_emira.name: Lotus Emira
acevo:ks_lotus_emira.notes: Emira V6 First Edition: Toyota 2GR 3.5 supercharged V6 at 405 PS, six-speed manual (Touring) or automatic (Sports), rear-drive (Lotus). Supercharged: turbo flag off, the bypass sigh is the lift-off. Road car: ABS and TC. Starting point: ac:lotus_evora_s (same supercharged V6 and manual).

acevo:ks_lotus_exige_v6_cup.name: Lotus Exige V6 Cup
acevo:ks_lotus_exige_v6_cup.notes: Series 3 Exige V6 Cup: Toyota 2GR 3.5 supercharged V6, six-speed manual, rear-drive (Lotus). Cup car keeps ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ac:lotus_exige_v6_cup and ams2:Lotus Exige V6 Cup (same car).

acevo:ks_porsche_718_cayman_gt4_rs.name: Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS
acevo:ks_porsche_718_cayman_gt4_rs.notes: 4.0 NA flat-six from the 911 GT3 at 500 PS, 9000 rpm, intakes beside the driver's head, seven-speed PDK, mid-engined, rear-drive (Porsche); Weissach variant. Road car: ABS and PSM. Starting point: ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_rs (same 4.0 flat-six family on a PDK), louder for the cabin-side intakes.

acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_rs.name: Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992)
acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_rs.notes: 992 GT3 RS: 4.0 NA flat-six at 525 PS, 9000 rpm, seven-speed PDK, rear-drive (Porsche); Clubsport and Weissach variants. Road car: ABS and PSM. Starting point: ac:ks_porsche_911_gt3_rs (991 GT3 RS, same engine family), a little more buzz for the 992's 9000 rpm.

acevo:ks_toyota_gr86.name: Toyota GR86
acevo:ks_toyota_gr86.notes: FA24 2.4 flat-four NA at 235 PS, six-speed manual, rear-drive (Toyota); the GT86's torque dip is gone. Road car: ABS and VSC. Starting point: ac:ks_toyota_gt86 (FA20 predecessor), a touch more thump for the bigger boxer, less lug.

acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_gti_mk8.name: Volkswagen Golf 8 GTI Clubsport
acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_gti_mk8.notes: Golf 8 GTI Clubsport: EA888 2.0 TSI inline-four turbo at 300 PS, seven-speed DSG, front-drive (VW). Road car: ABS and ESC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_a1s1 (EA888-family 2.0 TFSI), DSG-shaped clutch, front-drive.

acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_r_mk8.name: Volkswagen Golf 8 R
acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_r_mk8.notes: Golf 8 R: EA888 2.0 TSI inline-four turbo at 320 PS, seven-speed DSG, 4Motion with rear torque vectoring (VW). Road car: ABS and ESC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_a1s1 (EA888-family 2.0 TFSI with quattro), DSG-shaped clutch.

acevo:ks_alfa_romeo_75_turbo_evo.name: Alfa Romeo 75 Turbo Evoluzione
acevo:ks_alfa_romeo_75_turbo_evo.notes: 1987 Group A homologation special (500 built): 1.8 turbo inline-four (1762 cc), 155 CV, five-speed transaxle, rear-drive (Wikipedia, ultimatespecs). No ABS found in any source, no TC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro (1980s single-turbo lag and dump) on four cylinders, more transaxle lash.

acevo:ks_alfa_romeo_giulia_gta_sprint.name: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GTA
acevo:ks_alfa_romeo_giulia_gta_sprint.notes: 1965 Giulia Sprint GTA: 1570 cc twin-plug twin-cam inline-four (115 hp road, about 170 hp in Autodelta race trim), five-speed, rear-drive (Wikipedia). EVO classes it Racing Vintage (hotlap.cc), so the race trim fits. Nothing electronic. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_alfa_romeo_gta (same car).

acevo:ks_audi_sport_quattro.name: Audi Sport quattro
acevo:ks_audi_sport_quattro.notes: 1984 Sport quattro: 2.1 turbo inline-five at 306 PS, five-speed, quattro with a lockable centre diff (Audi; EVO 0.5 added the diff lock). ABS fitted (switchable), no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro (same car).

acevo:ks_bmw_m3_e30_evo_iii.name: BMW M3 E30 Sport Evo (Evolution III)
acevo:ks_bmw_m3_e30_evo_iii.notes: 1990 M3 Sport Evolution: S14 2.5 (2467 cc) inline-four NA at 238 PS, Getrag dogleg five-speed, rear-drive (BMW). ABS yes, no TC. Starting point: ac:bmw_m3_e30 (road S14 2.3), a bit more for the bigger, freer-revving Evo engine.

acevo:ks_bmw_m3_e46_csl.name: BMW M3 E46 CSL
acevo:ks_bmw_m3_e46_csl.notes: E46 M3 CSL: S54 3.2 inline-six NA with individual throttle bodies at 360 PS, 8000 rpm, six-speed SMG II automated manual, rear-drive (BMW). Road car: ABS and DSC. Starting point: ac:ks_bmw_m4 (BMW straight six) without the turbos, more buzz for the high-revving S54, harder SMG shift shunt.

acevo:ks_datsun_240z_fairlady.name: Datsun 240Z (S30)
acevo:ks_datsun_240z_fairlady.notes: S30 240Z: L24 2.4 SOHC inline-six on twin SU carburettors, about 150 hp, four or five-speed manual, rear-drive (Nissan; Wikipedia); Standard and Tuned variants. Nothing electronic. Starting point: ac:ks_toyota_ae86 (light 1970s-style RWD shell, synchro box), six cylinders: smoother rock, carburettor lope, heavier pulses at 18 Hz.

acevo:ks_ferrari_288_gto.name: Ferrari 288 GTO
acevo:ks_ferrari_288_gto.notes: 1984 288 GTO: 2.9 twin-turbo V8 at 400 CV, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Ferrari). No ABS, no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_ferrari_288_gto (same car).

acevo:ks_ferrari_f40_lm.name: Ferrari F40 LM
acevo:ks_ferrari_f40_lm.notes: Michelotto F40 LM race car: 2.9 twin-turbo V8 (F120) at about 720 hp, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Wikipedia). No ABS, no TC. Gearbox left synchro as in the AC F40s; set 1 if EVO's box is dog-engaged. Starting point: ac:ferrari_f40_s3 (more boost, open exhaust) taken further to race trim.

acevo:ks_ford_escort_rs_cosworth.name: Ford Escort RS Cosworth
acevo:ks_ford_escort_rs_cosworth.notes: Escort RS Cosworth: Cosworth YB 2.0 turbo inline-four with a big Garrett T35, 227 PS, five-speed, four-wheel drive (Ford; Wikipedia). ABS fitted, no TC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro (big single turbo, lag and dump, AWD on a synchro box) on four cylinders.

acevo:ks_honda_nsx_r.name: Honda NSX-R 92R
acevo:ks_honda_nsx_r.notes: 1992 NA1 NSX-R: C30A 3.0 V6 NA (VTEC) at 280 PS, 8000 rpm, five-speed manual, mid-engined, rear-drive (Honda). TCS deleted, ABS kept (one fan source; check). Starting point: ac:ks_nissan_370z (NA V6 on a road manual), revvier and lighter for the R.

acevo:ks_honda_s2000_ap1.name: Honda S2000 AP1
acevo:ks_honda_s2000_ap1.notes: AP1 S2000: F20C 2.0 inline-four NA (VTEC) at 250 PS, 9000 rpm, six-speed manual, rear-drive (Honda). ABS yes; VSA only came with the 2006 AP2, so no TC. Starting point: ac:ks_mazda_mx5_nd (light RWD four on a six-speed), much more buzz and less inertia for the 9000 rpm F20C, less lug.

acevo:ks_lamborghini_countach.name: Lamborghini Countach LP5000 QV
acevo:ks_lamborghini_countach.notes: LP5000 Quattrovalvole: 5.2 V12 NA (48 valves, six Webers) at 455 hp, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Lamborghini). No ABS, no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_lamborghini_countach (the same QV).

acevo:ks_lancia_delta_hf_integrale_evo_i.name: Lancia Delta HF integrale Evoluzione II
acevo:ks_lancia_delta_hf_integrale_evo_i.notes: Delta HF integrale Evoluzione II: 2.0 16v turbo inline-four at 215 CV, five-speed, permanent four-wheel drive (Lancia; Wikipedia); Evo 3 prototype variant. EVO models its ABS (0.2 notes fix the Lancia's ABS light), no TC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro (1980s turbo AWD rally homologation car) on four cylinders.

acevo:ks_mazda_mx5_na.name: Mazda MX-5 NA
acevo:ks_mazda_mx5_na.notes: NA MX-5: B6 1.6 inline-four NA at about 115 hp, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Mazda); RS Limited variant. No TC; ABS was an option, left off. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_mazda_miata (same car).

acevo:ks_mazda_rx7_fd.name: Mazda RX-7 FD Spirit R
acevo:ks_mazda_rx7_fd.notes: FD RX-7 Spirit R Type A: 13B-REW twin-rotor 1.3 with sequential twin turbos, 280 PS, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Mazda). ABS yes, no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_mazda_rx7_spirit_r (same car).

acevo:ks_mercedes_190e_evo_ii.name: Mercedes 190E 2.5-16 Evo II
acevo:ks_mercedes_190e_evo_ii.notes: 1990 road Evo II: M102 2.5 (2463 cc) inline-four with the Cosworth 16v head, 235 PS, five-speed dogleg manual, rear-drive (Mercedes-Benz). ABS standard; ASR left off (optional, unconfirmed). Starting point: ac:bmw_m3_e30 (the road homologation rival's big NA four). Not ac:ks_mercedes_190_evo2, which is the 375 hp DTM car.

acevo:ks_mini_jcs_1990.name: Mini John Cooper S
acevo:ks_mini_jcs_1990.notes: Mk VI Rover Mini Cooper with the John Cooper S kit: 1275 cc A-series inline-four NA (about 78 hp), four-speed in the sump, front-drive (Wikipedia); the Tune variant is a Honda B16 swap. Nothing electronic. Starting point: ams2:MINI Cooper S (1275 A-series, gearbox-in-sump whine), slightly fewer pops for the injected engine.

acevo:ks_peugeot_205_t16.name: Peugeot 205 T16
acevo:ks_peugeot_205_t16.notes: 1984 Group B road 205 Turbo 16: XU8T 1.8 (1775 cc) turbo inline-four at 200 PS, mid-mounted, five-speed, four-wheel drive (Peugeot; Wikipedia). No ABS, no TC. Starting point: ac:ks_audi_sport_quattro (Group B road turbo with AWD) on four cylinders, a little more gear noise from the transverse mid box.

acevo:ks_porsche_964_turbo_3_6.name: Porsche 911 Turbo 3.6 (964)
acevo:ks_porsche_964_turbo_3_6.notes: 964 Turbo 3.6: air-cooled 3.6 flat-six with one large turbo, 360 PS, five-speed manual, rear-drive (Porsche); X88 power-kit variant. ABS standard, no TC. Starting point: ac:ruf_yellowbird (air-cooled turbo boxer), lift-off a step down from its twin big turbos.

acevo:ks_renault_5_gt_turbo.name: Renault 5 GT Turbo
acevo:ks_renault_5_gt_turbo.notes: R5 GT Turbo: 1.4 (1397 cc) Cleon pushrod inline-four with a Garrett T2, 115 to 120 CV, five-speed, front-drive (Renault; Wikipedia); Raider variant. No ABS, no TC. Starting point: ac:abarth500 (small FWD turbo hatch), more lag and dump for the 1980s turbo, a busier idle.

acevo:ks_toyota_ae86_sprinter_trueno.name: Toyota Sprinter Trueno 1600GT-Apex (AE86)
acevo:ks_toyota_ae86_sprinter_trueno.notes: AE86 Sprinter Trueno GT-Apex: 4A-GE 1.6 twin-cam inline-four at 130 PS, five-speed, rear-drive (Toyota); Zenki, Kouki, Black Limited and Anime Tribute variants. No ABS, no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_toyota_ae86 (same car).

acevo:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv.name: Toyota Supra MKIV
acevo:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv.notes: Supra RZ: 2JZ-GTE 3.0 inline-six with sequential twin turbos, 280 PS, Getrag six-speed, rear-drive (Toyota). Road car: ABS and TRC (the Drift variant has neither; the effects are flag-driven, so it never fires there). Starting point: same values as ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv (same car; ac:ks_toyota_supra_mkiv_drift fits the Drift variant).

acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_gti_mk1.name: Volkswagen Golf GTI Mk1
acevo:ks_volkswagen_golf_gti_mk1.notes: Golf GTI Mk1: EA827 1.6 inline-four with K-Jetronic injection, 110 PS, four or five-speed manual, front-drive (VW; Wikipedia). Nothing electronic. Starting point: ams2:Gol Classic B (the same EA827 'AP' family four), smoother idle for the injection, front-drive.

acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt2.name: Audi R8 LMS GT2
acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt2.notes: R8 LMS GT2: 5.2 V10 NA at 640 hp, seven-speed S tronic DCT on paddles, rear-drive; ABS, TC and ESP adjustable (Audi press). Starting point: ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT4 (same V10 and S tronic), lifted toward the GT3 values for the GT2's power and race exhaust.

acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt3_evo_2.name: Audi R8 LMS GT3 Evo II
acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt3_evo_2.notes: R8 LMS GT3 evo II: 5.2 V10 NA (about 585 hp under BoP), six-speed sequential, rear-drive (Audi). GT3: ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT3 evo II (same car).

acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt4_evo.name: Audi R8 LMS GT4 Evo
acevo:ks_audi_r8_lms_gt4_evo.notes: R8 LMS GT4 evo: 5.2 V10 NA at about 495 hp, seven-speed S tronic, rear-drive (Audi). GT4: ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT4 (same engine and box).

acevo:ks_bmw_m2_cs_racing.name: BMW M2 CS Racing
acevo:ks_bmw_m2_cs_racing.notes: M2 CS Racing: S55 3.0 twin-turbo inline-six, 365 hp (450 hp power-stick variant, EVO 0.5), seven-speed M DCT, rear-drive; ABS and TC in motorsport calibration (BMW M Motorsport). Starting point: ac:ks_bmw_m235i_racing (BMW turbo-six cup car), racier exhaust and DCT shifts.

acevo:ks_bmw_m4_gt3.name: BMW M4 GT3 Evo
acevo:ks_bmw_m4_gt3.notes: M4 GT3 Evo: P58 3.0 twin-turbo inline-six at about 590 hp, Xtrac six-speed sequential, rear-drive (BMW). GT3: ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:BMW M4 GT3 (the Evo keeps the engine and box).

acevo:ks_caterham_academy.name: Caterham Academy
acevo:ks_caterham_academy.notes: Seven Academy race car: 1.6 Ford Sigma inline-four at about 135 hp, five-speed H-pattern, rear-drive (Caterham; PistonHeads). The Sigma was the Academy engine from 2008; the 2026 Academy moved to a 1.3 turbo after EVO's car shipped in 0.3. No ABS, no TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:Caterham Academy (same spec).

acevo:ks_dallara_exp.name: Dallara EXP
acevo:ks_dallara_exp.notes: Track-only EXP: Bosch-reworked 2.3 Ford EcoBoost inline-four turbo at about 500 CV, six-speed sequential, Quaife LSD, rear-drive, 890 kg (carscoops, motor1). ABS/TC fitment not found in any source: left at 40 because the effects are flag-driven (silent if the car has none). Starting point: engine from ac:ktm_xbow_r (turbo four behind you in a carbon tub) raised to race trim, sequential driveline from ams2:Alpine A110 GT4 EVO.

acevo:ks_ferrari_296_gt3.name: Ferrari 296 GT3
acevo:ks_ferrari_296_gt3.notes: 296 GT3: 3.0 120-degree twin-turbo V6 (no hybrid in GT3), Xtrac six-speed sequential, rear-drive (Ferrari). GT3: ABS and TC. Starting point: ac:ks_ferrari_488_gt3_2020 (Ferrari twin-turbo GT3 on a sequential), six cylinders and more buzz.

acevo:ks_ferrari_488_challenge_evo.name: Ferrari 488 Challenge Evo
acevo:ks_ferrari_488_challenge_evo.notes: 488 Challenge Evo: 3.9 twin-turbo V8 at 670 CV, F1 DCT with race shift maps (dog-shaped, as in the AC entry), rear-drive (Ferrari). ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_ferrari_488_challenge_evo (same car).

acevo:ks_ferrari_f2004.name: Ferrari F2004
acevo:ks_ferrari_f2004.notes: F2004: Tipo 053 3.0 V10 NA, about 900 hp, 19000 rpm, seven-speed sequential, rear-drive (Ferrari). 2004 F1: TC legal, no ABS. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_ferrari_f2004 (same car).

acevo:ks_ferrari_sf_25.name: Ferrari SF-25
acevo:ks_ferrari_sf_25.notes: SF-25 (2025 F1): 1.6 V6 turbo hybrid with MGU-K and MGU-H, eight-speed seamless sequential, rear-drive (Ferrari). F1 rules: no TC, no ABS. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_ferrari_sf70h (same power unit formula).

acevo:ks_ford_mustang_gt3.name: Ford Mustang GT3
acevo:ks_ford_mustang_gt3.notes: Mustang GT3: Coyote-based 5.4 V8 NA (Ford Performance and M-Sport), Xtrac six-speed sequential transaxle, rear-drive (Ford). GT3: ABS and TC. Starting point: engine from ac:ks_ford_mustang_2015 (Coyote cross-plane V8) in race trim, driveline from ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO (front V8 GT3 transaxle).

acevo:ks_ktm_x_bow_gt2.name: KTM X-Bow GT2
acevo:ks_ktm_x_bow_gt2.notes: X-Bow GT2: Audi 2.5 TFSI inline-five turbo at about 600 hp, six-speed sequential, rear-drive; GT2 class ABS and TC (KTM). Starting point: ac:ks_audi_tt_vln (same 2.5 five on a sequential dog box) raised to the GT2's power.

acevo:ks_ktm_x_bow_gt4.name: KTM X-Bow GT4
acevo:ks_ktm_x_bow_gt4.notes: X-Bow GT4: Audi 2.0 TFSI inline-four turbo at up to 360 PS (BoP), Holinger six-speed sequential, rear-drive; Bosch Motorsport ABS and TC (KTM, Hagerty). Starting point: engine from ac:ktm_xbow_r (same car family) in race trim, driveline from ams2:Alpine A110 GT4 EVO (turbo-four GT4 on a sequential).

acevo:ks_lamborghini_huracan_st_evo2.name: Lamborghini Huracan ST EVO2
acevo:ks_lamborghini_huracan_st_evo2.notes: Huracan Super Trofeo EVO2: 5.2 V10 NA at 620 CV, X-trac six-speed sequential, rear-drive (Lamborghini). ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as the AMS2 Super Trofeo EVO2 entry and ac:ks_lamborghini_huracan_st (same car). Name unaccented to match SimHub.

acevo:ks_maserati_mc20_gt2.name: Maserati GT2
acevo:ks_maserati_mc20_gt2.notes: MC20 GT2: Nettuno 3.0 twin-turbo V6 at about 620 hp, six-speed sequential on paddles replacing the road DCT, rear-drive (Maserati, motor1). ABS and TC. Starting point: engine from ams2:Maserati GT2 Stradale (same Nettuno V6) in race trim, sequential driveline from ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO.

acevo:ks_mazda_mx5_nd_cup.name: Mazda MX-5 ND Cup
acevo:ks_mazda_mx5_nd_cup.notes: Global MX-5 Cup ND: sealed 2.0 SkyActiv-G inline-four NA, six-speed manual, rear-drive (Mazda); ND1 and ND2 variants. ABS kept, no TC. Starting point: same values as ac:ks_mazda_mx5_cup (same car).

acevo:ks_mercedes_amg_gt2.name: Mercedes-AMG GT2
acevo:ks_mercedes_amg_gt2.notes: AMG GT2: M178 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at about 700 hp, six-speed sequential transaxle, rear-drive (Mercedes-AMG). ABS and TC. Starting point: engine from ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT4 (same M178) in race trim, sequential driveline from ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO.

acevo:ks_porsche_718_cayman_gt4_cs_mr.name: Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport
acevo:ks_porsche_718_cayman_gt4_cs_mr.notes: 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport (Manthey, the id's MR): 3.8 flat-six NA at 425 PS, six-speed PDK, rear-drive (Porsche). ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:Porsche Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR (981 predecessor, same engine family and PDK).

acevo:ks_porsche_935.name: Porsche 935
acevo:ks_porsche_935.notes: 2019 935: GT2 RS Clubsport base, 3.8 twin-turbo flat-six at 700 PS, seven-speed PDK, rear-drive (Porsche). ABS and TC. Starting point: ac:ks_porsche_991_turbo_s (3.8 twin-turbo boxer on a PDK) in race trim; same values as ks_porsche_991ii_gt2_rs_clubsport_evo.

acevo:ks_porsche_991ii_gt2_rs_clubsport_.name: Porsche 911 GT2 RS Clubsport Evo (991II)
acevo:ks_porsche_991ii_gt2_rs_clubsport_.notes: 991.2 GT2 RS Clubsport with the Evo kit: 3.8 twin-turbo flat-six at 700 PS, seven-speed PDK, rear-drive (Porsche). ABS and TC. Starting point: ac:ks_porsche_991_turbo_s (3.8 twin-turbo boxer on a PDK) in race trim; same values as ks_porsche_935 (same engine and box).

acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_cup.name: Porsche 911 GT3 Cup (992)
acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_cup.notes: 992 GT3 Cup: 4.0 flat-six NA at 510 PS, six-speed sequential, rear-drive (Porsche). EVO ships ABS TC, ABS and No ABS No TC variants under one id; the effects are flag-driven, so 40 % fires only when the variant has them (the AMS2 entry is 0/0 for the Supercup spec). Starting point: feel values from ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 Cup (992) (same car).

acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_r_rennsport.name: Porsche 992 GT3 R Rennsport
acevo:ks_porsche_992_gt3_r_rennsport.notes: 911 GT3 R rennsport (menu name Porsche 911 GT3 R Rennsport (992); the name here is the shorter string seen in telemetry, see ROSTER.md): 4.2 flat-six NA at about 620 hp free of BoP, six-speed sequential, rear-drive (Porsche); GT3 and Unrestricted variants. ABS and TC. Starting point: same values as ams2:Porsche 992 GT3-R (same engine and box).

acr:Alfa_Romeo_GTA.name: Alfa Romeo GTA 1300 Junior Gr.2
acr:Alfa_Romeo_GTA.notes: 1972 Group 2 GTA 1300 Junior (Autodelta): 1290 cc twin-cam, twin-plug inline-four, naturally aspirated, five-speed H-pattern, rear drive. Starting point: the feel values of the AC Alfa Romeo GTA (ac:ks_alfa_romeo_gta, its 1.6 sister car) reused unchanged, litres set to 1.3 (scales the thump weight only). Nothing electronic: no ABS, no TC.

acr:Citroen Xsara WRC.name: Citroen Xsara WRC
acr:Citroen Xsara WRC.notes: World Rally Car (2001 on the Steam page, 2003 in some lists): 2.0 turbo inline-four, six-speed non-synchronised X-Trac sequential, four-wheel drive. WRC anti-lag: constant overrun bangs (pops 1.0), a violent lift (1.8). Starting point: the AMS2 rallycross values reused unchanged (the same 2.0 turbo anti-lag, AWD, sequential dog box recipe; the lift matches the AC Toyota Celica ST185). No ABS, no TC.

acr:FIAT 131 Abarth.name: Fiat 131 Abarth Gr.4
acr:FIAT 131 Abarth.notes: 1976 Group 4 131 Abarth Rally: Lampredi 1995 cc twin-cam inline-four with a 16-valve head on Kugelfischer mechanical injection, naturally aspirated, rear drive, straight-cut ZF five-speed dog-leg with front (dog) engagement. Starting point: between the AC Ford Escort RS1600 (Group 2 rally four with a straight-cut dog box, whine 0.9, lope) and the AC BMW M3 E30 Group A (big race four, thump 1.0): rock 0.85, thump 0.95, lope 0.5; the Escort's driveline. No ABS, no TC.

acr:FIAT Abarth 124 Rally.name: FIAT 124 Sport Abarth Rally 16V Gr.4
acr:FIAT Abarth 124 Rally.notes: Group 4 124 Abarth Rally in its 16-valve works form (1973 on the Steam page): 1.8 twin-cam inline-four with the Abarth 16-valve head on Kugelfischer injection, naturally aspirated, rear drive, close-ratio straight-cut Colotti five-speed (taken as dog engagement, as a Colotti racing box). Starting point: the 131 Abarth values here a touch lighter (litres 1.8, thump 0.9, amp 48), themselves from the AC Escort RS1600 and BMW M3 E30 Group A. No ABS, no TC.

acr:Hyundai i20N Rally2.name: Hyundai i20N Rally2
acr:Hyundai i20N Rally2.notes: 2021 Rally2: 1.6 turbo inline-four on the Rally2 restrictor, five-speed sequential dog box (Hyundai Motorsport), four-wheel drive. Anti-lag as on every Rally2 car: overrun bangs and a hard lift. Starting point: the AMS2 rallycross values (Citroen DS3RX and the other three: 2.0 turbo anti-lag, AWD, sequential dog box) with lift and pops a step down for half the power (1.7, 0.9, amp 48); driveline unchanged. No ABS, no TC (Rally2 rules).

acr:Lancia 037.name: Lancia Rally 037 EVO 2 Gr.B
acr:Lancia 037.notes: 1984 Group B Evo 2: 2111 cc twin-cam 16-valve inline-four with a Volumex Roots supercharger, mid-mounted, rear drive, ZF five-speed transaxle modified by Abarth with dog engagement. A supercharger has no turbo lag and needs no anti-lag: turbo flag off, a blower sigh on lift (1.2, the AMS2 Caterham 620R recipe). Starting point: the AC BMW M3 E30 Group A engine (big race four: rock 0.8, thump near 1.0) with the 620R's lift; the driveline of the AC Audi Sport quattro S1 E2 (Group B dog box) with a little less shunt (0.7). No ABS, no TC.

acr:Lancia Delta Integrale Evo.name: Lancia Delta HF integrale EVO Gr.A
acr:Lancia Delta Integrale Evo.notes: 1992 Group A Delta HF integrale Evoluzione: 1995 cc Lampredi twin-cam 16-valve turbo inline-four on the Group A restrictor, permanent four-wheel drive. Group A works cars of the era ran anti-lag (boost held on the overrun) and straight-cut rally boxes. Starting point: the AC Toyota Celica ST185 values reused unchanged (the same 1992 Group A recipe: 2.0 turbo four, anti-lag, AWD, dog box); the gear count and dog engagement are not confirmed for the works Delta. No ABS, no TC.

acr:Lancia Stratos HF.name: Lancia Stratos Gr.4
acr:Lancia Stratos HF.notes: 1976 Group 4 Stratos HF: Ferrari Dino 2418 cc 65-degree V6, naturally aspirated, mid-mounted, rear drive, five-speed dog-leg transaxle (the late Group 4 box is fully synchronised: synchro, straight-cut gears so whine 0.6). Starting point: the AC Alfa Romeo 155 V6 (a smooth V6, high buzz) pulled back towards a 1970s race engine (buzz 0.85, thump 0.75, lope 0.4, more inertia), with open-exhaust pops near the AC Alfa Romeo GTA's (0.8). No ABS, no TC.

acr:Mini Cooper S 1275.name: Mini Cooper S Gr.2
acr:Mini Cooper S 1275.notes: 1964 Group 2 Cooper S: 1275 cc BMC A-series inline-four (the game's own id says 1275), naturally aspirated and carburetted, four-speed H-pattern in the sump sharing the engine oil, front drive. Starting point: the AMS2 MINI Cooper S 1965 values reused unchanged (same engine, box and layout). Nothing electronic: no ABS, no TC.

acr:Peugeot 208 Rally4.name: Peugeot 208 Rally4
acr:Peugeot 208 Rally4.notes: 2020 Rally4: 1199 cc PureTech turbo three-cylinder (208 PS), SADEV five-speed sequential with a mechanical limited slip, front drive. No anti-lag found in the sources: a small turbo's flutter on lift (1.3) and light pops. Starting point: the triple's rock from the AMS2 Volkswagen Polo TSI Cup (0.7 at a 20 Hz carrier) on a race engine, the driveline of the AMS2 Renault Clio Cup (SADEV sequential, whine 0.7). No ABS, no TC.

acr:alpine_a110.name: Alpine A110 Group 4
acr:alpine_a110.notes: 1973 Group 4 A110 (the 1973 world championship car is the A110 1800): 1796 cc Renault inline-four, naturally aspirated on twin Webers, rear-mounted, rear drive, five-speed manual. Starting point: the AC Alfa Romeo GTA (a carburetted race four of the same era, lope 0.5) at 1.8 litres, the GTA's synchro driveline with a little more gear noise (0.5). Added in EA 0.2 (18 Dec 2025). No ABS, no TC.

acr:audi_quattro.name: Audi Quattro Gr.4
acr:audi_quattro.notes: 1980 Group 4 Quattro (the Rally Algarve course car): 2.1 turbo inline-five, about 320 hp, permanent four-wheel drive with a mechanically locked centre diff (EA 0.6 changelog). 1980 predates anti-lag: real turbo lag, a big dump on lift (1.8), overrun crackle only (pops 0.6). Starting point: the AC Audi Sport quattro Step1 engine (the same five's warble at a 20 Hz carrier, lift 1.8), the road quattro's H-pattern synchro driveline with more gear noise and shunt for a rally build (whine 0.4, shunt 0.7). Added in EA 0.6 (10 Sep 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:lancia_fulvia.name: Lancia Fulvia Coupé 1.6 HF Gr.4
acr:lancia_fulvia.notes: 1970 Group 4 Fulvia Coupe 1.6 HF (the Fanalone): Lancia's narrow-angle V4 (one cylinder head), 1584 cc, naturally aspirated, front drive, close-ratio five-speed dog-leg. Layout V for the narrow V4. Starting point: the AC Alfa Romeo GTA engine (a carburetted race four of the same years) a little rougher at idle, the front-drive driveline of the AMS2 MINI Cooper S 1965. Added in EA 0.3 (26 Feb 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:peugeot_206_wrc.name: Peugeot 206 WRC
acr:peugeot_206_wrc.notes: 1999 World Rally Car (the first-year car): 2.0 turbo inline-four, about 300 hp (EA 0.6 changelog), longitudinal six-speed X-Trac sequential, four-wheel drive. WRC anti-lag. Starting point: the Citroen Xsara WRC values here reused unchanged (same WRC recipe; those are the AMS2 rallycross values). Added in EA 0.6 (10 Sep 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:peugeot_306_maxi.name: Peugeot 306 Maxi Kit Car
acr:peugeot_306_maxi.notes: 1997 F2 Kit Car: 2.0 16-valve inline-four (XU10J4 based), naturally aspirated and revving past 10,000 rpm, sequential dog box (six speeds in most sources), front drive, about 960 kg. No turbo, no anti-lag. Starting point: the high-revving recipe of the AC Alfa Romeo 155 V6 TI (buzz near 1, low inertia, sharp limiter, sequential whine 1.0) on a four (thump 0.7 at a 26 Hz carrier). Added in EA 0.4 (30 Apr 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:skoda_fabia_rs_rally2.name: ŠKODA Fabia RS Rally2
acr:skoda_fabia_rs_rally2.notes: 2022 Rally2: 1.6 turbo inline-four on the Rally2 restrictor, five-speed sequential dog box, four-wheel drive. Anti-lag as on every Rally2 car (the EA 0.4 changelog added its exhaust after-fire and Rally2 turbo). Starting point: the Hyundai i20N Rally2 values here reused unchanged (same class and recipe; those come from the AMS2 rallycross set, toned down). Added in EA 0.3 (26 Feb 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:subaru_impreza.name: Subaru Impreza S3 Gr.A
acr:subaru_impreza.notes: 1993 Group A Impreza 555 (Prodrive): 1994 cc EJ20 turbo flat-four with intercooler, about 300 hp restricted, six-speed manual (not sequential), active diffs, four-wheel drive. Subaru's anti-lag is the loud, aggressive kind: pops 1.0. Starting point: the AC Toyota Celica ST185 (1992 Group A 2.0 turbo, anti-lag, AWD) with a boxer's gruffness after the AC Toyota GT86 and an unequal-length burble (lope 0.45, rock 0.75, thump 0.85 at a 20 Hz carrier); gearbox dog as the Celica's (the sources only say six-speed manual). Added in EA 0.4 (30 Apr 2026). No ABS, no TC.

acr:volkswagen_polo_gti_r5.name: Volkswagen Polo GTI R5
acr:volkswagen_polo_gti_r5.notes: 2018 R5 (Rally2): 1.6 turbo inline-four, 272 hp, 400 Nm, five-speed sequential, 1230 kg, permanent four-wheel drive with front and rear limited slips (EA 0.6 changelog). Anti-lag as on every R5. Starting point: the Hyundai i20N Rally2 values here reused unchanged (same class). Added in EA 0.6 (10 Sep 2026). No ABS, no TC.
